q: When a man commits adultery, faith departs from him as if it were a cloud overhead. When he stops what he is doing, faith returns to him.

title: Hadith on Islam: People of the Book given double reward
t: Abu Umamah reported: I was beside the camel of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, on the day of liberation. The speech of the Prophet was beautiful and most excellent, among which he said, “Whoever embraces Islam from the people of the two Books will have his reward twice. He will have what we have and be responsible as we are. Whoever embraces Islam from the idolaters will have his reward. He will have what we have and be responsible as we are.”
q: Whoever embraces Islam from the people of the two Books will have his reward twice. He will have what we have and be responsible as we are. Whoever embraces Islam from the idolaters will have his reward. He will have what we have and be responsible as we are.

title: Hadith on Shirk: Word of faith absolves from idolatry
t: Abdullah ibn Salam reported: We were travelling with the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, when people were heard saying, “Which deeds are best, O Messenger of Allah?” The Prophet said, “Faith in Allah and His Messenger, jihad in the way of Allah, and a righteous Hajj pilgrimage.” Then, a caller was heard in the valley, “I bear witness there is no God but Allah and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah!” The Prophet said, “I bear witness as well! I testify that no one bears witness to it but that he is innocent of idolatry.”
q: Faith in Allah and His Messenger, jihad in the way of Allah, and a righteous Hajj pilgrimage. … I bear witness as well! I testify that no one bears witness to it but that he is innocent of idolatry.
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Arna’ut

title: Hadith on Tawhid: Word of faith leads to salvation from sin
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever says there is no God but Allah, it will eventually save him regardless of what he had committed in the past.”
q: Whoever says there is no God but Allah, it will eventually save him regardless of what he had committed in the past.

title: Hadith on Jannah: The Prophet hopes for united families in Paradise
t: Rifa’ah al-Juhani reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “I testify before Allah that no servant dies bearing witness there is no God but Allah and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah and then does what is right, except that he will find his way into Paradise. My Lord Almighty has promised me that seventy thousand of my nation will enter Paradise without reckoning or punishment. Verily, I hope you will not enter Paradise until all of you settle together in the heavenly residences with your righteous forefathers, your spouses, and your progeny.”
q: I testify before Allah that no servant dies bearing witness there is no God but Allah and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah and then does what is right, except that he will find his way into Paradise. My Lord Almighty has promised me that seventy thousand of my nation will enter Paradise without reckoning or punishment. Verily, I hope you will not enter Paradise until all of you settle together in the heavenly residences with your righteous forefathers, your spouses, and your progeny.

title: Hadith on Tawhid: Encourage dying to say testimony of faith
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Inspire your dying to declare there is no God but Allah, for whoever says there is no God but Allah as his last words at death, he will enter Paradise in time regardless of what he had committed beforehand.”
q: Inspire your dying to declare there is no God but Allah, for whoever says there is no God but Allah as his last words at death, he will enter Paradise in time regardless of what he had committed beforehand.

title: Hadith on Tawhid: Believers’ property and blood sacred to Allah
t: Abu Malik al-Ashja’i reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever declares the unity of Allah and denies whatever is worshipped besides Him, then Allah has made his wealth and life sacred, and his reckoning is upon Allah Almighty.”
q: Whoever declares the unity of Allah and denies whatever is worshipped besides Him, then Allah has made his wealth and life sacred, and his reckoning is upon Allah Almighty.

title: Hadith on Hereafter: Sinful believers enter Paradise after punishment
t: Salamah ibn Nu’aym reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever meets Allah without associating any partners with Him will eventually enter Paradise.” I said, “Even if he commits adultery and theft?” The Prophet said, “Even if he commits adultery and theft.”
q: Whoever meets Allah without associating any partners with Him will eventually enter Paradise. … Even if he commits adultery and theft.

title: Hadith on Tawhid: Umar afraid they take Allah’s mercy for granted
t: Abu Bakr reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Go out and announce to the people that whoever testifies there is no God but Allah will surely enter Paradise.” I went out and was met by Umar ibn al-Khattab. Umar said, “Return to the Messenger of Allah, for I fear they will take it for granted.” I returned to the Messenger of Allah and he said, “Why have you come back?” I told him what Umar had said, and the Prophet said, “He spoke the truth.”
q: Go out and announce to the people that whoever testifies there is no God but Allah will surely enter Paradise. … Why have you come back? … He spoke the truth.

title: Hadith on Sins: True believers upset by their bad deeds
t: Abu Musa reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever performs a good deed and is pleased with it, and commits a sin and is distressed by it, then he is a believer.”
q: Whoever performs a good deed and is pleased with it, and commits a sin and is distressed by it, then he is a believer.
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Arna’ut

title: Hadith on Deen: The Prophet describes Islam, faith, virtues
t: ‘Amr ibn ‘Abasah reported: I came to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, saying, “O Messenger of Allah, who is with you in this matter?” The Prophet said, “The free and the enslaved.” I said, “What is Islam?” The Prophet said, “Kind words and feeding the hungry.” I said, “What is faith?” The Prophet said, “Patience and tolerance.” I said, “Whose Islam is best?” The Prophet said, “One from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.” I said, “Whose faith is best?” The Prophet said, “One with good character.” I said, “Which prayer is best?” The Prophet said, “One with a long supplication.” I said, “Which emigration is best?” The Prophet said, “To emigrate away from what is hated by the Lord Almighty.” I said, “Whose jihad is best?” The Prophet said, “One whose horse has fallen and his blood gushes forth.” I said, “Which hours are best?” The Prophet said, “The depths of the late night.”
q: The free and the enslaved. … Kind words and feeding the hungry. … Patience and tolerance. … One from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe. … One with good character. … One with a long supplication. … To emigrate away from what is hated by the Lord Almighty. … One whose horse has fallen and his blood gushes forth. … The depths of the late night.
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Arna’ut

title: Hadith on Deen: What are the signs of Islam?
t: Mu’awiyah ibn Haydah reported: I said, “O Prophet of Allah, I ask you by the face of Allah Almighty, with what did your Lord send you?” The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Islam.” I said, “What are the signs of Islam?” The Prophet said, “That you declare the surrender of your face to Allah Almighty, relinquish your old ways, perform prayer, and give charity. Every Muslim is sacred to another Muslim, two brothers supporting each other. Allah Almighty will not accept the good deeds of an idolater after he embraces Islam until he leaves the idolaters for the Muslims.”
q: Islam. … That you declare the surrender of your face to Allah Almighty, relinquish your old ways, perform prayer, and give charity. Every Muslim is sacred to another Muslim, two brothers supporting each other. Allah Almighty will not accept the good deeds of an idolater after he embraces Islam until he leaves the idolaters for the Muslims.

title: Hadith on Jannah: Are there horses in Paradise?
t: Abu Ayyub reported: A bedouin came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and he said, “O Messenger of Allah, I love horses. Will there be horses in Paradise?” The Prophet said, “If you enter Paradise, you will be given a horse of rubies with two wings to mount, then it will fly with you wherever you wish.”
q: If you enter Paradise, you will be given a horse of rubies with two wings to mount, then it will fly with you wherever you wish.
gf: Hasan li ghayrihi (fair due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Shahadah: Forgiveness for testifying faith with certainty
t: Mu’adh ibn Jabal reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “No soul upon the earth dies while not associating partners with Allah and testifying that I am the Messenger of Allah, repeating it in his heart with conviction, but that he will be forgiven.”
q: No soul upon the earth dies while not associating partners with Allah and testifying that I am the Messenger of Allah, repeating it in his heart with conviction, but that he will be forgiven.

title: Hadith on Tawhid: The Prophet knows the word of salvation
t: Umar ibn al-Khattab reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, I know a word that no servant truthfully says in his heart and dies upon it but that Allah will forbid him from entering Hellfire: There is no God but Allah.”
q: Verily, I know a word that no servant truthfully says in his heart and dies upon it but that Allah will forbid him from entering Hellfire: There is no God but Allah.

title: Hadith on Shahadah: Testimony of faith necessitates Paradise
t: Suhayl ibn Bayda’ reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, whoever testifies there is no God but Allah, then Allah will forbid him from entering Hellfire and require him to enter Paradise.”
q: Verily, whoever testifies there is no God but Allah, then Allah will forbid him from entering Hellfire and require him to enter Paradise.
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Shahadah: Testimony of faith protects from Hellfire
t: Abu ‘Amrah reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “I testify there is no God but Allah and I am the Messenger of Allah. I testify before Allah that no believing servant meets Him with these two statements but he will be shielded from the Hellfire on the Day of Resurrection.”
q: I testify there is no God but Allah and I am the Messenger of Allah. I testify before Allah that no believing servant meets Him with these two statements but he will be shielded from the Hellfire on the Day of Resurrection.
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Tawhid: Mu’adh’s final Hadith before he passes away
t: Jabir reported: When death was approaching Mu’adh ibn Jabal, may Allah be pleased with him, he said, “Lift the cloth from my face. I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, say: Whoever testifies that there is no God but Allah, sincerely from his heart, he will enter Paradise.”
q: Whoever testifies that there is no God but Allah, sincerely from his heart, he will enter Paradise.

title: Hadith on Tawhid: Lest they take Allah’s mercy for granted
t: Abu Musa reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Rejoice and give glad tidings that whoever honestly says there is no God but Allah will enter Paradise!” They went out and announced glad tidings to the people, and they were met by Umar, may Allah be pleased with him. They gave him glad tidings but he sent them back. The Prophet said, “Who sent you back?” They said, “Umar.” The Prophet said, “Why did you send them back, O Umar?” Umar said, “In that case, the people will take it for granted, O Messenger of Allah.”
q: Rejoice and give glad tidings that whoever honestly says there is no God but Allah will enter Paradise! … Who sent you back? … Why did you send them back, O Umar?

title: Abdul Wahid on Contentment: Pleasure with Allah’s decree is Paradise of this world
t: Al-Sarri ibn Hassan reported: Abdul Wahid ibn Zayd, may Allah have mercy on him, said, “Contentment is one of the greatest doors to Allah, the Paradise of this world, and the repose of the worshipers.”

title: Hadith on Faith: Love for Allah a sign of Allah’s love for him
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever is pleased to know the relationship of Allah to him, let him examine his relationship with Allah.”
q: Whoever is pleased to know the relationship of Allah to him, let him examine his relationship with Allah

title: Ibn Umar on Qadr: Accepting Allah’s decree at death of a beloved
t: Nafi’ reported: A son of Abdullah ibn Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, complained of an illness and Ibn Umar was very distraught over him so much that some people said: We are afraid for this old man because of what might happen to his boy! The boy died and Ibn Umar went out to his funeral. There was not a man more visibly happy than him, so he was asked why. Ibn Umar said, “Verily, it was only mercy for him and when the decree of Allah came to pass, we accepted it.”
s: al-Riḍā ʻan Allāh bi-Qaḍāʼihi li-Ibn Abī al-Dunyā 98

title: Abdullah on Qadr: Eating hot coals better than opposing Allah’s decrees
t: Al-Hasan reported: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “That I taste a hot coal, scorching or leaving what it may, is more beloved to me than were I to say about something that happened, ‘Would that it not be so!’ or about something that did not happen, ‘Would that it were so!’”

title: Abu Darda on Qadr: Peak of faith is acceptance of Allah’s decree
t: Al-Lalaka’i reported: Abu Darda, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “The pinnacle of faith is in four things: patience with the judgment of Allah, pleasure with the decree of Allah, sincerity and trust in Allah, and surrender to the Lord.”
s: Sharḥ Uṣūl I’tiqād Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jamā’ah 1697

title: Abdullah on Qadr: Accept Allah’s decree with patience or gratitude
t: Qays ibn Khabtar reported: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “Accept two things you dislike: death and poverty. By Allah, there is nothing but richness and poverty, and I do not care with which of them I am put to trial, for the right of Allah in each of them must be fulfilled. If it is richness, then in it is appreciation. If it is poverty, then in it is patience.”

title: Umar on Qadr: I accept Allah’s decree, like it or not
t: Sufyan reported: Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “I do not care if I wake up to what I like or dislike, for I do not know if goodness is found in what I like or dislike.”

title: Hadith on Tawbah: One who repents is without sin
t: Abu Sa’id al-Ansari reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Regret is part of repentance, and one who truly repents is like one without sin.”
q: Regret is part of repentance, and one who truly repents is like one without sin.

title: Hadith on Conscience: Allah makes his heart admonish him with good
t: Umm Salamah reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “When Allah intends goodness for a servant, He appoints a conscience within him to command and prohibit him.”
q: When Allah intends goodness for a servant, He appoints a conscience within him to command and prohibit him.

title: Umar II on Qadr: O Allah, content me with Your divine decree
t: Yahya ibn Sa’id reported: Umar ibn Abdul Aziz, may Allah have mercy on him, would supplicate often, saying, “O Allah, make me pleased with Your decree and bless me in Your providence, such that I would not like to hasten anything You delay, nor delay anything You hasten.”
s: al-Riḍā ʻan Allāh bi-Qaḍāʼihi li-Ibn Abī al-Dunyā 46

title: Hadith on Enjoining: Collective punishment for failure to stop evil
t: Jarir reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “No man commits sinful disobedience among a people, although they could prevent him but do not, except that Allah will strike them all with punishment before they die.”
q: No man commits sinful disobedience among a people, although they could prevent him but do not, except that Allah will strike them all with punishment before they die.
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Arna’ut

title: Hadith on Shaytan: Devil comes to distract believers in prayer
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “When the call to prayer is announced, Satan turns his back and he passes wind to avoid hearing it. When the call is finished, he turns around until the call for commencement is announced and then turns his back again. When the commencement is finished, he turns around until he provokes thoughts within a man, saying, ‘Remember this and that,’ persistently mentioning what was not on his mind until a man does not know how much he has prayed.”
q: When the call to prayer is announced, Satan turns his back and he passes wind to avoid hearing it. When the call is finished, he turns around until the call for commencement is announced and then turns his back again. When the commencement is finished, he turns around until he provokes thoughts within a man, saying, ‘Remember this and that,’ persistently mentioning what was not on his mind until a man does not know how much he has prayed.
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Trials: Believers admire reward of those who suffered
t: Jabir reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The people who lived in prosperity will wish on the Day of Resurrection to have the reward of those who were put to trial, even if their skin had been torn away with shears.”
q: The people who lived in prosperity will wish on the Day of Resurrection to have the reward of those who were put to trial, even if their skin had been torn away with shears.

title: Ali on Qadr: Acceptance of Allah’s decree even if unpleasant
t: Al-Agharr reported: Ali ibn Abi Talib, upon him be peace, saw ‘Adi ibn Hatim in dismay. Ali said, “O ‘Adi, what is wrong that I see you sad and distressed?” ‘Adi said, “Why should I not be when my sons have been killed and my eye has been gouged?” Ali said, “O ‘Adi, whoever is pleased with the decree of Allah passing over him will have a reward. Whoever is not pleased with the decree of Allah passing over him will have his good deeds negated.”
s: al-Riḍā ʻan Allāh bi-Qaḍāʼihi li-Ibn Abī al-Dunyā 15

title: Hadith on Trials: Blessings a test of gratitude, obedience to Allah
t: Hudhayfah reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “In the wealth of a man is a trial, and in his wife and children are a trial.”
q: In the wealth of a man is a trial, and in his wife and children are a trial.

title: Hadith on Treachery: Every betrayal announced on Judgment Day
t: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Every treacherous liar will have a banner raised over him on the Day of Resurrection. It will be said: This is the betrayal of this person!”
q: Every treacherous liar will have a banner raised over him on the Day of Resurrection. It will be said: This is the betrayal of this person!

title: Hadith on Betrayal: Treachery exposed to all on Judgment Day
t: Anas reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Every treacherous liar will have a banner raised over him on the Day of Resurrection by which he will be known.”
q: Every treacherous liar will have a banner raised over him on the Day of Resurrection by which he will be known
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Suhur: Allah and angels bless the pre-fasting meal
t: Ibn Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, Allah and His angels send blessings upon those who eat before fasting.”
q: Verily, Allah and His angels send blessings upon those who eat before fasting.

title: Hadith on Tyranny: Humiliation of unjust rulers on Judgment Day
t: Abu Sa’id al-Khudri reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Every treacherous liar will have a banner raised over him on the Day of Resurrection, according to the measure of his betrayal. Surely, there is no greater betrayal than that committed by a ruler over the common people.”
q: Every treacherous liar will have a banner raised over him on the Day of Resurrection, according to the measure of his betrayal. Surely, there is no greater betrayal than that committed by a ruler over the common people.

title: Hadith on Rights: Every claimant is entitled to speak
t: Abu Huraira reported: A man came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, seeking the settlement of his loans and he spoke harshly to him. This disturbed his companions, but the Prophet said, “Leave him alone, for everyone with a right is entitled to speak.”
q: Leave him alone, for everyone with a right is entitled to speak
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Abraham: Ibrahim is the ally of the Prophet
t: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, every Prophet has an ally among the Prophets and surely my ally is my father, Abraham, the intimate friend of my Lord, upon him be peace.” Then, the Prophet recited the verse, “Verily, the closest to Abraham are those who followed him, this Prophet, and those who have faith, for Allah is the ally of the believers.” (3:68)
q: Verily, every Prophet has an ally among the Prophets and surely my ally is my father, Abraham, the intimate friend of my Lord, upon him be peace. … Verily, the closest to Abraham are those who followed him, this Prophet, and those who have faith, for Allah is the ally of the believers

title: Hadith on Purity: Cleansed by righteous deeds before he dies
t: Abu Umamah reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “When Allah intends goodness for a servant, he purifies him before his death.” They said, “O Messenger of Allah, what is the purification of the servant?” The Prophet said, “Righteous deeds inspired in him until his soul is taken up.”
q: When Allah intends goodness for a servant, he purifies him before his death … Righteous deeds inspired in him until his soul is taken up.

title: Hadith on Firasah: Some believer can sense people’s hearts
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, Allah Almighty has servants who can know the hearts of people by their discerning of signs.”
q: Verily, Allah Almighty has servants who can know the hearts of people by their discerning of signs.

title: Hadith on Salaam: Our greetings of peace reach the Prophet
t: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, Allah has angels who journey through the earth to convey to me the greetings of peace from my nation.”
q: Verily, Allah has angels who journey through the earth to convey to me the greetings of peace from my nation.

title: Hadith on Angels: Truth spoken by angels on tongues of people
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, Allah has angels who speak upon the tongues of the children of Adam about whether a man was good or evil.”
q: Verily, Allah has angels who speak upon the tongues of the children of Adam about whether a man was good or evil.

title: Hadith on Patience: Be calm at the first shock of calamity
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Patience is at the first strike of calamity. Patience is at the first strike of calamity.”
q: Patience is at the first strike of calamity. Patience is at the first strike of calamity.

title: Hadith on Dua: Ask Allah for satisfaction with the Divine Decree
t: ‘Ammar ibn Yasir reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “O Allah, I ask You for contentment with the decree of providence.”
q: O Allah, I ask You for contentment with the decree of providence.

title: Hadith on Nasihah: Islam is goodwill to Allah and the people
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said three times, “The religion is sincere goodwill.” They said, “To whom?” The Prophet said, “To Allah, to His Book, to the leaders of the Muslims and their common people.”
q: The religion is sincere goodwill. … To Allah, to His Book, to the leaders of the Muslims and their common people.

title: Hadith on Ramadan: The Prophet strives most in last ten nights
t: Aisha reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, would exert himself in worship during the last ten nights of Ramadan more so than any other time.

title: Hadith on Salah: Punishment for ignoring Quran, skipping prayers
t: Samurah ibn Jundub reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, saw in a dream, “As for the one whose head was crushed by a stone, he had taken the Quran but refused to act upon it, and he slept through the prescribed prayers.”
q: As for the one whose head was crushed by a stone, he had taken the Quran but refused to act upon it, and he slept through the prescribed prayers.

title: Hadith on Jannah: Angels announce eternal bliss of Paradise
t: Abu Sa’id al-Khudri reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “A heavenly caller will announce: Verily, you will be healthy and never sick again! You will live and never die again! You will be young and never grow old again! Such is the word of the Almighty: They will be called, this is your Paradise that you have inherited for what you have done!” (7:43)
q: A heavenly caller will announce: Verily, you will be healthy and never sick again! You will live and never die again! You will be young and never grow old again! Such is the word of the Almighty: They will be called, this is your Paradise that you have inherited for what you have done!

title: Hadith on the Hour: Arabia to become green before the Last Day
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The Hour will not be established until wealth is so abundant and overflowing that a man will go out with his wealth to give alms but not find anyone who accepts it from him, and until rivers and meadows return to the land of Arabia.”
q: The Hour will not be established until wealth is so abundant and overflowing that a man will go out with his wealth to give alms but not find anyone who accepts it from him, and until rivers and meadows return to the land of Arabia.

title: Hadith on Quran: Book of Allah intercedes for its reciters
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Recite the Quran, for it is the most excellent intercessor on the Day of Resurrection. It will say: O Lord, adorn him with the noblest of ornaments! Thus, he will be adorned with the noblest of ornaments. It will say: O Lord, dress him in the noblest of garments! Thus, he will be dressed in the noblest of garments. It will say: O Lord, crown him with the noblest of crowns! O Lord, be pleased with him, for after Your pleasure there is nothing!”
q: Recite the Quran, for it is the most excellent intercessor on the Day of Resurrection. It will say: O Lord, adorn him with the noblest of ornaments! Thus, he will be adorned with the noblest of ornaments. It will say: O Lord, dress him in the noblest of garments! Thus, he will be dressed in the noblest of garments. It will say: O Lord, crown him with the noblest of crowns! O Lord, be pleased with him, for after Your pleasure there is nothing!

title: Hadith on Faith: Love your neighbor as yourself
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “None of you will have faith until he loves for his brother or his neighbor what he loves for himself.”
q: None of you will have faith until he loves for his brother or his neighbor what he loves for himself.

title: Hadith on Concern: Excellence in Islam to avoid useless interests
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Among the perfection of one’s Islam is to leave what does not concern him.”
q: Among the perfection of one’s Islam is to leave what does not concern him

title: Hadith on Sunnah: Do not dispute with the Prophet
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Leave me with what I have left for you. When I narrate a saying to you, take it from me. Verily, those before you were only ruined because they excessively interrogated and disputed their prophets.”
q: Leave me with what I have left for you. When I narrate a saying to you, take it from me. Verily, those before you were only ruined because they excessively interrogated and disputed their prophets.

title: Hadith on Thanks: Gratefulness to people is gratitude to Allah
t: Al-Ash’ath ibn Qays reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever is not grateful to people is not grateful to Allah.”
q: Whoever is not grateful to people is not grateful to Allah.
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Arna’ut

title: Hadith on Faith: Let him be generous to his neighbor
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his neighbor.”
q: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his neighbor.

title: Hadith on Tyranny: The Prophet disowns supporters of evil rulers
t: Abu Sa’id al-Khudri reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “There will be rulers after me whose malevolence will deceive the people. Whoever affirms their lies and helps their wrongdoing, I disavow myself from him and he is disavowed from me. Whoever does not affirm their lies, nor helps their wrongdoing, I am part of him and he is part of me.”
q: There will be rulers after me whose malevolence will deceive the people. Whoever affirms their lies and helps their wrongdoing, I disavow myself from him and he is disavowed from me. Whoever does not affirm their lies, nor helps their wrongdoing, I am part of him and he is part of me.
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Hawd: Supporters of tyranny forbidden from the Fountain
t: Khabbab ibn al-Aratt reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, there will be rulers after me, so do not affirm their lies, nor help them in their wrongdoing. Whoever affirms their lies and helps them in their wrongdoing, he will be turned away from me at the Fountain.”
q: Verily, there will be rulers after me, so do not affirm their lies, nor help them in their wrongdoing. Whoever affirms their lies and helps them in their wrongdoing, he will be turned away from me at the Fountain.

title: Hadith on Tyranny: Warning not to help evil rulers in their sins
t: Al-Nu’man ibn Bashir reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Surely, there will be rulers after me who tell lies and commit oppression. Whoever affirms their lies and advises them in their wrongdoing, then he is not part of me and I am not part of him. Whoever does not affirm their lies, nor advise them in their wrongdoing, then he is part of me and I am part of him. Verily, the Muslim whose blood is shed is an expiation for him. Verily, the glorification of Allah, the praise of Allah, the declaration there is no God but Allah, and Allah is the greatest, these righteous deeds will endure.”
q: Surely, there will be rulers after me who tell lies and commit oppression. Whoever affirms their lies and advises them in their wrongdoing, then he is not part of me and I am not part of him. Whoever does not affirm their lies, nor advise them in their wrongdoing, then he is part of me and I am part of him. Verily, the Muslim whose blood is shed is an expiation for him. Verily, the glorification of Allah, the praise of Allah, the declaration there is no God but Allah, and Allah is the greatest, these righteous deeds will endure.
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Arna’ut

title: Hadith on Graves: Punishment in graves for failing to help oppressed
t: Ibn Mas’ud reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “One of the servants of Allah was commanded to be flogged in his grave with a hundred lashings. He continued to beg and plead until it was reduced to a single lashing, then his grave became filled with fire. When it was taken away from him, he said: May I know why you flogged me? It will be said: You performed prayer without ablution, and when you passed by an oppressed person, you did not help him.”
q: One of the servants of Allah was commanded to be flogged in his grave with a hundred lashings. He continued to beg and plead until it was reduced to a single lashing, then his grave became filled with fire. When it was taken away from him, he said: May I know why you flogged me? It will be said: You performed prayer without ablution, and when you passed by an oppressed person, you did not help him

title: Hadith on Retribution: Good deeds destroyed by wronging others
t: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The record of a man will be presented to him on the Day of Resurrection until he thinks he has been saved, but the ones he wronged among the children of Adam will continue to pursue him until none of his good deeds remain and their sins will be piled upon him.”
q: The record of a man will be presented to him on the Day of Resurrection until he thinks he has been saved, but the ones he wronged among the children of Adam will continue to pursue him until none of his good deeds remain and their sins will be piled upon him.

title: Hadith on Wrongdoing: Satan pleased when Muslims oppress each other
t: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, Satan has despaired that idols will be worshipped in the land of the Arabs, but rather he will be pleased with you for less than that by the sins you belittle, which are punishments on the Day of Resurrection. Guard against acts of wrongdoing as much as you can, for a servant will come with good deeds on the Day of Resurrection that he thinks will save him. Another servant will stand and continue to say: O Lord, Your servant has done great wrong to me! It will be said: Erase his good deeds! Such will continue until no good deeds compare to his many sins. Verily, the parable of that is like a group of travelers who settles in a barren land with no firewood, so the people disperse in search of firewood and before long they find it and kindle a large fire to cook whatever they wish. Such is the way of sins.”
q: Verily, Satan has despaired that idols will be worshipped in the land of the Arabs, but rather he will be pleased with you for less than that by the sins you belittle, which are punishments on the Day of Resurrection. Guard against acts of wrongdoing as much as you can, for a servant will come with good deeds on the Day of Resurrection that he thinks will save him. Another servant will stand and continue to say: O Lord, Your servant has done great wrong to me! It will be said: Erase his good deeds! Such will continue until no good deeds compare to his many sins. Verily, the parable of that is like a group of travelers who settles in a barren land with no firewood, so the people disperse in search of firewood and before long they find it and kindle a large fire to cook whatever they wish. Such is the way of sins
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Brotherhood: Muslims remain brothers, unless they sin
t: Ibn Umar reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The Muslims is the brother of another Muslim. He does not wrong him, nor forsake him. By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, no two people who love each other for Allah and then separate but that it was due to a sin committed by one of them.”
q: The Muslims is the brother of another Muslim. He does not wrong him, nor forsake him. By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, no two people who love each other for Allah and then separate but that it was due to a sin committed by one of them.

title: Hadith on Oppression: The Prophet never intercedes for tyrants or renegades
t: Abu Umamah reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Two kinds of people from my nation will never receive my intercession: an oppressive and malevolent leader, and every extremist renegade.”
q: Two kinds of people from my nation will never receive my intercession: an oppressive and malevolent leader, and every extremist renegade.

title: Hadith on Bribery: Taking bribes is an act of lesser unbelief
t: Abu al-Ahwas reported: Ibn Mas’ud, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “Bribery to receive a favorable judgement is an act of unbelief, and between people it is illicit.”
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Leaders: Three terrible stages of leading, unless fair
t: ‘Awf ibn Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “If you wish, shall I not tell you what is leadership? The first of it is blameworthy, the second of it is regret, and the third of it is punishment, unless he is just.”
q: If you wish, shall I not tell you what is leadership? The first of it is blameworthy, the second of it is regret, and the third of it is punishment, unless he is just.

title: Hadith on Responsibility: Allah asks how dependents were treated
t: Anas reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, every guardian will be asked about those under his care. Did he preserve that or squander it? Even a man will be asked about the people of his household.”
q: Verily, every guardian will be asked about those under his care. Did he preserve that or squander it? Even a man will be asked about the people of his household.

title: Hadith on Sahaba: Master of martyrs is great companion Hamzah
t: Ali ibn Abi Talib reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The master of the martyrs is Hamza ibn ‘Abdul Muttalib.”
q: The master of the martyrs is Hamza ibn ‘Abdul Muttalib.

title: Hadith on Sultan: Allah honors those who respect His authority
t: Abu Bakrah reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever honors the authority of Allah in the world, Allah will honor him on the Day of Resurrection.”
q: Whoever honors the authority of Allah in the world, Allah will honor him on the Day of Resurrection.

title: Shafi’i on Popularity: You cannot please everyone, benefit yourself instead
t: Yunus ibn ‘Abd al-‘Ala reported: Al-Shafi’i, may Allah be pleased with him, said to me, “Pleasing people is a goal you can never achieve, and I know of no way to be safe from them, so you must be concerned with what benefits you and hold onto it.”

title: Ibn Abbas on Nur: I ask You by the Light of Your Face
t: Sa’id ibn Jubayr reported: Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with him, used to say, “O Allah, I ask You by the light of Your Face, which shines over the heavens and the earth, that you place me within Your fortress, Your protection, Your guardianship, and under Your shadow.”
gf: Rijal al-Sahih (narrators reliable) according to Al-Haythami

title: Hadith on Rulers: Warning not to obey leaders if they order sin
t: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “There will be rulers appointed over you who delay the prayer from its proper times and invent new heresies.” Abdullah said, “What should I do if I see them?” The Prophet said, “You ask me, O son of Umm ‘Abd, what you should do? There is no obedience to one who orders disobedience to Allah.”
q: There will be rulers appointed over you who delay the prayer from its proper times and invent new heresies. … You ask me, O son of Umm ‘Abd, what you should do? There is no obedience to one who orders disobedience to Allah.

title: Hadith on Quran: Balanced recitation between hope and fear
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, this Quran was revealed in seven modes, so there is no blame upon whichever you recite. Yet, do not end at a mention of mercy without also remembering punishment, nor end at a mention of punishment without also remembering mercy.”
q: Verily, this Quran was revealed in seven modes, so there is no blame upon whichever you recite. Yet, do not end at a mention of mercy without also remembering punishment, nor end at a mention of punishment without also remembering mercy.

title: Hadith on Caliphs: Ali testifies for Abu Bakr and Umar
t: ‘Abdu Khayr reported: Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “Shall I not inform you of the best from this nation after its Prophet? It is Abu Bakr, and the best after him is Umar. Then, Allah will place goodness wherever He wishes.”

title: Hadith on Ghuraba: Blessed strangers leaving their idolatrous tribes
t: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, Islam began as a something strange and it will return to being strange, so blessed are the strangers.” It was said, “Who are the strangers?” The Prophet said, “Those who removed themselves from their tribes.”
q: Verily, Islam began as a something strange and it will return to being strange, so blessed are the strangers. … Those who removed themselves from their tribes.

title: Sa’id on Salah: Visualizing the Day of Resurrection in prayer
t: Abu Abdur Rahman reported: I said to Sa’id ibn Abdul Aziz, may Allah have mercy on him, “O Abu Muhammad, what is this weeping that confronts you in your prayer?” Sa’id said, “O nephew, why do you ask about it?” He said, “O uncle, perhaps Allah will benefit me.” Sa’id said, “I never stood for my prayer but that the image of Hell appeared before me.”

title: Hadith on Sahaba: Speak carefully about Companions, stars, providence
t: Thawban reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “If my companions are mentioned, be restrained. If the stars are mentioned, be restrained. If the divine decree is mentioned, be restrained.”
q: If my companions are mentioned, be restrained. If the stars are mentioned, be restrained. If the divine decree is mentioned, be restrained.

title: Hadith on Loyalty: Firmest faith is alliance and disavowal for Allah
t: Ibn Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, the firmest handle of faith is loyalty for the sake of Allah, enmity for the sake of Allah, love for the sake of Allah, and hatred for the sake of Allah.”
q: Verily, the firmest handle of faith is loyalty for the sake of Allah, enmity for the sake of Allah, love for the sake of Allah, and hatred for the sake of Allah.
gf: Hasan li ghayrihi (fair due to external evidence) according to Al-Arna’ut

title: Ibn Abbas on Sahaba: Seek forgiveness for companions in the Fitnah
t: Mujahid reported: Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “Do not curse the companions of Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, for Allah Almighty commanded seeking forgiveness for them even though He knew they would fight each other.”

title: Hadith on Sha’ban: The Prophet connects fasting Ramadan and Sha’ban
t: Aisha reported: The most beloved month to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, for fasting was Sha’ban, then he would connect it with Ramadan.

title: Hadith on Quran: Seek Allah by His Book before insincerity prevails
t: Jabir ibn Abdullah reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Recite the Quran and seek Allah through it before some people come who merely sharpen its form as if it were an arrow, seeking reward in the world and not in the Hereafter.”
q: Recite the Quran and seek Allah through it before some people come who merely sharpen its form as if it were an arrow, seeking reward in the world and not in the Hereafter.

title: Abu Umamah on Quran: Allah will not punish a heart preserving His Book
t: Al-Qasim reported: Abu Umamah, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “Recite the Quran and do not be mistaken about these connected pages, for Allah will not punish a heart that preserves the Quran.”

title: Hadith on Jama’ah: Hand of Allah above united Muslim community
t: ‘Arfajah ibn Shurayh reported: I saw the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, delivering a sermon to the people, saying, “Verily, the Hand of Allah is over the united community, for Satan is with one who secedes from the community, running after him.”
q: Verily, the Hand of Allah is over the united community, for Satan is with one who secedes from the community, running after him.

title: Hadith on Rulers: Tyrants will make false claims from Minbar
t: Mu’awiyah reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “There will be leaders after me who make false claims from their pulpits, and no one will refute their words. They will leap into the Hellfire as if they were apes.”
q: There will be leaders after me who make false claims from their pulpits, and no one will refute their words. They will leap into the Hellfire as if they were apes.

title: Hadith on the Hour: World to be dominated by foolish dynasties
t: Abdul Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Soon the world will be dominated by the fool, son of the fool, son of the fool. The best of people will be a believer between an honorable grandparent and an honorable child.”
q: Soon the world will be dominated by the fool, son of the fool, son of the fool. The best of people will be a believer between an honorable grandparent and an honorable child.

title: Hadith on Dajjal: Twenty-seven false prophets appear in Ummah
t: Hudhayfah reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “In my nation, there will be twenty-seven great liars and impostors, among whom are four women. Verily, I am the seal of the prophets, and there is no prophet after me.”
q: In my nation, there will be twenty-seven great liars and impostors, among whom are four women. Verily, I am the seal of the prophets, and there is no prophet after me.

title: Hadith on Sujud: Hypocrites unable to prostrate on Judgment Day
t: Abu Sa’id al-Khudri reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Our Lord will reveal His shin and every believing man and woman will prostrate to Him, but there will remain those who prostrated in the world for ostentation and respectability. They will try to prostrate, but their back will be as stiff as a single bone.”
q: Our Lord will reveal His shin and every believing man and woman will prostrate to Him, but there will remain those who prostrated in the world for ostentation and respectability. They will try to prostrate, but their back will be as stiff as a single bone.

title: Ahmad on Rulers: Supplication for guidance of Caliphs and Imams
t: Abu Bakr al-Marrudhi reported: I heard Ahmad ibn Hanbal, may Allah have mercy on him, mentioning the Caliph al-Mutawakkil and he said, “Indeed, I pray for his righteousness and well-being.”

title: Hadith on Oppression: Supplication when fearing a tyrannical ruler
t: Sa’id ibn Jubayr reported: Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “If an imposing ruler comes to you and you fear he will pillage you, then say three times: Allah is the greatest! Allah is more powerful than all His creation together! Allah is mightier than what I fear and worry! I seek refuge in Allah, there is no God but Him, the Holder of the seven heavens lest they fall upon the earth but by His permission, from the evil of Your servant, this man, his soldiers, his followers, and his partisans among jinn and humanity! O Allah, be my protector from his evil, for majestic is Your praise, mighty is Your protection, and blessed is Your name. There is no God besides You!”

title: Hadith on Sultan: Supplication when fearing an oppressive ruler
t: Al-Harith ibn Suwayd reported: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “If a leader is appointed over you from whom you fear arrogance or injustice, let him say: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Mighty Throne, be my protector against this man, the son of this man, and his partisans among Your creatures, lest one of them transgress against me or oppress me. Powerful is Your protection and majestic is Your praise, for there is no God but You.”

title: Hadith on Sultan: Prohibition of supplicating against Muslim rulers
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The elders among the Companions of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, prohibited us, saying, “Do not curse your leaders, do not deceive them, and do not hate them. Fear Allah and be patient, for the matter is close at hand.”

title: Malik on Tawhid: Attributes of Allah are above any modality
t: Abdullah ibn Wahb reported: We were with Malik ibn Anas, may Allah have mercy on him, when a man entered and he said, “O Abu Abdullah, ‘the Most Merciful rose above the Throne,’ (20:5). How did He rise?” Malik bowed his head in silence until he began to sweat, then he said, “The Most Merciful rose above the Throne as He described himself, and it was not said ‘how’ He did so. A modality is not attributable to Him. You are an evil man and a carrier of heresy. Expel him!” Then, the man was expelled.
q: the Most Merciful rose above the Throne

title: Hadith on the Hour: Calamities when party culture arises in the Ummah
t: Sahl ibn Sa’d reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “There will come at the end of time the collapse of cities, stones raining from the sky, and the transmutation of creatures.” It was said, “When is that, O Messenger of Allah?” The Prophet said, “When there is a prevalence of musical instruments, singing girls, and the legalization of wine.”
q: There will come at the end of time the collapse of cities, stones raining from the sky, and the transmutation of creatures. … When there is a prevalence of musical instruments, singing girls, and the legalization of wine.

title: Hadith on the Hour: Calamities appear when evil prevails in the Ummah
t: Aisha reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “At the end of this nation will be the collapse of cities, the transmutation of creatures, and stones raining from the sky.” Aisha said, “O Messenger of Allah, will we be destroyed while the righteous are among us?” The Prophet said, “Yes, when wickedness prevails.”
q: At the end of this nation will be the collapse of cities, the transmutation of creatures, and stones raining from the sky … Yes, when wickedness prevails.

title: Hadith on Gluttony: Party animals in Ummah turn into monkeys and pigs
t: Ibn Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Some people from this nation of mine will spend the night eating, drinking, and partying, but by the morning they will have transformed into apes and swine.”
q: Some people from this nation of mine will spend the night eating, drinking, and partying, but by the morning they will have transformed into apes and swine.
gf: Hasan li ghayrihi (fair due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Tribulations: Prevalence of sudden death a sign of the Hour
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “From the nearness of the Hour is that the crescent moon will be sighted enlarged and it will be said it is the second night, that the mosques will be taken as mere fairways, and that sudden death will become prevalent.”
q: From the nearness of the Hour is that the crescent moon will be sighted enlarged and it will be said it is the second night, that the mosques will be taken as mere fairways, and that sudden death will become prevalent

title: Hadith on Signs: Allah protects from three, warns from three
t: Abu Malik al-Ash’ari reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, your Lord has protected you from three things coming to pass: that your Prophet would not pray for the destruction of all of you, that the people of falsehood would not prevail over the people of truth, and that you will not unanimously agree upon misguidance. Allah has protected you from these. Your Lord warns you of three others. First, the smoke that will take the believer like a gentle breeze but seize the unbeliever with such an odor overtaking him from wherever he feels it. Second, the Beast. Third, the False Messiah.”
q: Verily, your Lord has protected you from three things coming to pass: that your Prophet would not pray for the destruction of all of you, that the people of falsehood would not prevail over the people of truth, and that you will not unanimously agree upon misguidance. Allah has protected you from these. Your Lord warns you of three others. First, the smoke that will take the believer like a gentle breeze but seize the unbeliever with such an odor overtaking him from wherever he feels it. Second, the Beast. Third, the False Messiah.
gf: Jayyid (very good) according to Ibn Kathir

title: Hadith on Tribulations: No piety, brotherhood, or respect signs of the Hour
t: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, among the signs of the Hour is that a man would pass through the mosque without even praying two cycles, that a man would only greet with peace those whom he knows, and that children will expect the elders to serve them.”
q: Verily, among the signs of the Hour is that a man would pass through the mosque without even praying two cycles, that a man would only greet with peace those whom he knows, and that children will expect the elders to serve them.

title: Hadith on Death: Remembering death balances hope in the Hereafter
t: Ibn Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Remember often the destroyer of pleasures: death. Verily, no one living with plenty does so but that it diminishes his vain hopes, nor one living with little but that it increases his hope in Allah.”
q: Remember often the destroyer of pleasures: death. Verily, no one living with plenty does so but that it diminishes his vain hopes, nor one living with little but that it increases his hope in Allah

title: Hadith on Qabr: Those killed by stomach injuries not punished in grave
t: Sulayman ibn Surad reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever is killed by a stomach injury will not be punished in his grave.”
q: Whoever is killed by a stomach injury will not be punished in his grave

title: Hadith on Cleanliness: Punishment in grave due to soiling yourself
t: Ibn Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The majority of torment in the grave is due to carelessness with urine, so avoid soiling yourself with urine.”
q: The majority of torment in the grave is due to carelessness with urine, so avoid soiling yourself with urine.

title: Hadith on Tahara: Punishment in grave for uncleanliness with urine
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Most of the torment in the grave is due to carelessness with urine.”
q: Most of the torment in the grave is due to carelessness with urine.

title: Hadith on Barzakh: Muslims who die on Friday protected from the grave
t: Abdullah ibn Amr reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “No Muslim passes away on Friday, or its night, but that Allah will protect him from the trial of the grave.”
q: No Muslim passes away on Friday, or its night, but that Allah will protect him from the trial of the grave.

title: Hadith on Jesus: Son of Mary to perform Hajj upon his second coming
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “By the One in whose hand is my soul, the son of Mary will surely answer the call of the Hajj pilgrimage in the valley of Al-Rawha’, or for Umrah, or both together.”
q: By the One in whose hand is my soul, the son of Mary will surely answer the call of the Hajj pilgrimage in the valley of Al-Rawha’, or for Umrah, or both together

title: Hadith on Funerals: Angels prod those who wail over his grave
t: Abu Musa al-Ash’ari reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “No person dies and people stand over him wailing, saying, ‘What a great man he was! How dignified he was!’ but that two angels are appointed over him to prod him, saying, ‘Is that really how you were?’”
q: No person dies and people stand over him wailing, saying, ‘What a great man he was! How dignified he was!’ but that two angels are appointed over him to prod him, saying, ‘Is that really how you were?’

title: Hadith on Khalifah: Virtues of the great commander Zayd ibn Harithah
t: Aisha reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, never dispatched Zayd ibn Harithah with an army but that he appointed him commander over them. If he had lived after the Prophet, he would have appointed him as the Caliph.

title: Hadith on Hawd: Be patient with oppression until you meet the Prophet
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said to the Ansar, “Verily, you will encounter favoritism after me, so be patient until you meet me at your promised place by the Fountain in the Hereafter.”
q: Verily, you will encounter favoritism after me, so be patient until you meet me at your promised place by the Fountain in the Hereafter.

title: Salaf on Shaytan: Do not fight the devil, rather turn to Allah
t: Al-Qurtubi reported: One of the righteous predecessors said to his student, “What will you do if Satan entices you to sin?” The student said, “I will fight him!” The elder said, “And if he returns?” The student said, “I will fight him!” The elder said, “And if he returns?” The student said, “I will fight him!” The elder said, “This will take too long. What do you think if you passed by some sheep and its guard dog barked at you and prevented you from crossing? What would you do?” The student said, “I would endure and renew my efforts.” The elder said, “This would take too long. Rather, seek help from the owner of the sheep and He will suffice you.”

title: Hadith on Islam: True Muslims do no harm by words or deeds
t: Mu’adh ibn Anas reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand people are safe.”
q: The Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand people are safe.
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Arna’ut

title: Hadith on Death: Do not speak evil about the deceased
t: Aisha reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “When your companion dies, leave him alone and do not malign him.”
q: When your companion dies, leave him alone and do not malign him.

title: Hadith on Intercession: Righteous intercede for sinful brethren
t: Abu Sa’id al-Khudri reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “By the One in whose hand is my soul, none among you are more fervent to claim a right from Allah on the Day of Resurrection than the believers on behalf of their brothers in the Hellfire. They will say: Our Lord, they fasted, prayed, and performed pilgrimage with us! It will be said to them: Take out those whom you recognize. Thus, the Hellfire is forbidden for their bodies and they will take out many people.”
q: By the One in whose hand is my soul, none among you are more fervent to claim a right from Allah on the Day of Resurrection than the believers on behalf of their brothers in the Hellfire. They will say: Our Lord, they fasted, prayed, and performed pilgrimage with us! It will be said to them: Take out those whom you recognize. Thus, the Hellfire is forbidden for their bodies and they will take out many people.
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Sunnah: Innovated deeds of worship are rejected
t: Aisha reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever performs a deed that is not in accordance with our matter, it will be rejected.”
q: Whoever performs a deed that is not in accordance with our matter, it will be rejected.

title: Hadith on Jannah: Right-hand gate to Paradise for those without reckoning
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “It will be said on the Day of Resurrection: O Muhammad! Admit those from your nation, who will not be held to account, through the right-hand gate among the gates of Paradise, yet they will still share the other gates with the rest of the people.”
q: It will be said on the Day of Resurrection: O Muhammad! Admit those from your nation, who will not be held to account, through the right-hand gate among the gates of Paradise, yet they will still share the other gates with the rest of the people.
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Ghazali on Tafakkur: Visualizing the Judgment Day in quiet reflection
t: Al-Ghazali reported: Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak, may Allah have mercy on him, said to Sahl ibn ‘Ali as he was in silent contemplation, “Where have you gone?” Sahl said, “The Bridge over the Hellfire.”

title: Hadith on Funerals: Dead are tortured by wailing over them
t:
Umar ibn al-Khattab reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The deceased are tormented by their families wailing over them.”

Ibn al-Mubarak said, “I hope he would be spared from that if he prohibited them while he was alive.”
q: The deceased are tormented by their families wailing over them.

title: Hadith on Teaching: Best Muslims teach Quran they have learned
t: Ali ibn Abi Talib reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.”
q: The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.

title: Hadith on Humility: Best scholars know to say Allah knows best
t: Masruq reported: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “O people, fear Allah! Whoever among you knows something, let him say what he knows. Whoever does not know, let him say: Allah knows best. Verily, the most knowledgeable of you is one who says when he does not know: Allah knows best.”

title: Hadith on the Hour: Extreme depravity near the end of days
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “By the One in whose hand is my soul, this nation will not perish until a man mounts a woman and they fornicate in the street. The best among them in that time will merely say: If only you had taken her around the corner!”
q: By the One in whose hand is my soul, this nation will not perish until a man mounts a woman and they fornicate in the street. The best among them in that time will merely say: If only you had taken her around the corner!

title: Hadith on Death: Every human is constricted in the grave
t: Ibn Abbas reported: On the day the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, buried Sa’d ibn Mu’adh, he was sitting over his grave and he said, “If anyone were to be saved from the trial of the grave, it would have been Sa’d ibn Mu’adh. He was given a mighty squeezing, but then he was relaxed.”

title: Ibn Mas’ud on Shaytan: Devil incites worldly people until they kill
t: ‘Amr ibn Maymun reported: Ibn Mas’ud, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “Verily, Satan went around a gathering that was remembering Allah to tempt them, but he was unable to cause separation between them. Then, he went towards a circle that was remembering the world and he provoked them until they killed each other.”

title: Hadith on Fitnah: Standing firm during end-times tribulations
t: Abdullah ibn Amr reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Soon there will come a time in which the people are sifted and only the dregs of humanity remain, their covenants and trusts are disordered, and they are set against each other.” They said, “How should we be, O Messenger of Allah?” The Prophet said, “Keep to what you recognize as good and leave off what you recognize as evil. Turn your attention to your own personal affairs and leave off the affairs of the masses.”
q: Soon there will come a time in which the people are sifted and only the dregs of humanity remain, their covenants and trusts are disordered, and they are set against each other. … Keep to what you recognize as good and leave off what you recognize as evil. Turn your attention to your own personal affairs and leave off the affairs of the masses.

title: Hadith on Dhikr: People of Paradise grieved by forgetting Allah
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “No people sit in a gathering in which they did not remember Allah, nor send blessings upon the Prophet, but that it will cause them grief on the Day of Resurrection, even if they are rewarded with entry into Paradise.”
q: No people sit in a gathering in which they did not remember Allah, nor send blessings upon the Prophet, but that it will cause them grief on the Day of Resurrection, even if they are rewarded with entry into Paradise.

title: Hadith on Dhikr: Warning to not forget Allah in assemblies
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “No people stand up from a gathering in which they did not remember Allah but that it is as if they have risen from the carcass of a donkey, and it will cause them grief.”
q: No people stand up from a gathering in which they did not remember Allah but that it is as if they have risen from the carcass of a donkey, and it will cause them grief.

title: Hadith on ‘Ujb: Recommendation to recite Quran in private
t:
‘Uqbah ibn ‘Amir reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “One who recites the Quran publicly is like one who gives charity publicly, and one who recites privately is like one who gives charity privately.”

Al-Tirmidhi said, “According to the scholars, the meaning is that private recital protects a man from conceit because one who performs deeds in secret does not fear vanity for himself in the same way as if he did them openly.”
q: One who recites the Quran publicly is like one who gives charity publicly, and one who recites privately is like one who gives charity privately.

title: Hadith on Shaytan: Devil attacks believers who are alone
t: Mu’adh ibn Jabal reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, Satan is a wolf amongst humanity like the wolf who seizes the sheep wandering and straying from the flock. Beware of the winding mountain paths. You must stay with the wider community.”
q: Verily, Satan is a wolf amongst humanity like the wolf who seizes the sheep wandering and straying from the flock. Beware of the winding mountain paths. You must stay with the wider community.
gf: Hasan li ghayrihi (fair due to external evidence) according to Al-Arna’ut

title: Hadith on Companions: Ten Sahaba promised Paradise
t: Sa’id ibn Zayd reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “There are ten in Paradise. Abu Bakr is in Paradise and Umar is in Paradise. Uthman, Ali, Al-Zubayr, Talhah, Abdur Rahman ibn Awf, Abu ‘Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah, Sa’d ibn Abi Waqqas, and Abu al-A’war Sa’id ibn Zayd are in Paradise.”
q: There are ten in Paradise. Abu Bakr is in Paradise and Umar is in Paradise. Uthman, Ali, Al-Zubayr, Talhah, Abdur Rahman ibn Awf, Abu ‘Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah, Sa’d ibn Abi Waqqas, and Abu al-A’war Sa’id ibn Zayd are in Paradise.

title: Hadith on Dua: The Prophet liked comprehensive supplications
t: Aisha reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, preferred comprehensive supplications and he would leave off anything else.

title: Hadith on Tahajjud: Night prayer is practice of the righteous
t: Abu Umamah reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “You must perform the night prayer for it is the habit of the righteous who came before you, it brings you closer to your Lord, it expiates your evil deeds, and prevents you from sinning.”
q: You must perform the night prayer for it is the habit of the righteous who came before you, it brings you closer to your Lord, it expiates your evil deeds, and prevents you from sinning.

title: Hadith on Istighfar: Not a sinner if sincerely repenting
t: Abu Bakr reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “One is not a stubborn sinner if he sincerely seeks forgiveness from Allah, even if he were to do it seventy times in a day.”
q: One is not a stubborn sinner if he sincerely seeks forgiveness from Allah, even if he were to do it seventy times in a day

title: Hadith on Tahajjud: Awf witnesses the Prophet’s night prayer
t: Awf ibn Malik reported: I stood with the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, to pray at night. The Prophet began to recite Surat al-Baqarah and he would not pass by a verse of mercy but that he would ask for it, nor did he pass by a verse of punishment but that he sought refuge from it. Then, the Prophet bowed for as long as he stood, saying in his bowings, “Glory to Him with Power, Dominion, Grandeur, and Majesty.” The Prophet prostrated for as long as he stood, saying the same in his prostrations. Then, the Prophet began to recite Surat Ali ‘Imran and then he recited another chapter and another.
q: Glory to Him with Power, Dominion, Grandeur, and Majesty

title: Hadith on Satan: Shaytan withdraws when Allah is remembered
t: Mu’adh ibn Jabal reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, Satan has a snout like that of a dog positioned over the son of Adam, reminding him of his lusts and his pleasures, bringing him vain hopes and bringing his whisperings to incite doubt in his Lord. When the servant says, ‘I seek refuge in Allah, the Seeing, the Knowing, from the cursed Satan, I seek refuge in Allah lest they be present with me, for Allah alone is the Seeing and the Knowing.’ Then, Satan withdraws his snout from over his heart.”
q: “Verily, Satan has a snout like that of a dog positioned over the son of Adam, reminding him of his lusts and his pleasures, bringing him vain hopes and bringing his whisperings to incite doubt in his Lord. When the servant says, ‘I seek refuge in Allah, the Seeing, the Knowing, from the cursed Satan, I seek refuge in Allah lest they be present with me, for Allah alone is the Seeing and the Knowing.’ Then, Satan withdraws his snout from over his heart.

title: Hadith on Salat: Allah faces him in prayer unless he looks elsewhere
t: Abu Dharr reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Allah Almighty continues to face towards the servant while he is in prayer as long as he does not avert his eyes. If he looks elsewhere, Allah will turn elsewhere.”
q: Allah Almighty continues to face towards the servant while he is in prayer as long as he does not avert his eyes. If he looks elsewhere, Allah will turn elsewhere.
gf: Sahih li gharyihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Arna’ut

title: Hadith on Tasbih: The Prophet counts his glorifications of Allah
t: Abdullah ibn Amr reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, counting the glorifications of Allah with his fingers.

title: Hadith on Sujud: Looking at place of prostration in prayer
t: Aisha reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, entered the Ka’bah and his eyesight was not diverted from his place of prostration until he exited from it.

title: Hadith on Salah: Prayer with humility, dignity, tranquility
t: Al-Muttalib reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Prayer is offered two cycles at a time, a sitting testimony offered after each two cycles, that you humbly express need, with calm and dignity, and you raise your hands, saying: O Allah! O Allah! Whoever has not done so has been deficient.”
q: Prayer is offered two cycles at a time, a sitting testimony offered after each two cycles, that you humbly express need, with calm and dignity, and you raise your hands, saying: O Allah! O Allah! Whoever has not done so has been deficient.

title: Hadith on Qadr: Destiny decreed while in the mother’s womb
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Allah has appointed an angel over every womb. He says: O Lord, a drop! O Lord, a clot! O Lord, a bit of flesh! Then if Allah decrees the completion of its creation, he says: O Lord, male or female? O Lord, damned or saved? What is the provision? What is the lifespan? All of that is written in the womb of his mother.”
q: Allah has appointed an angel over every womb. He says: O Lord, a drop! O Lord, a clot! O Lord, a bit of flesh! Then if Allah decrees the completion of its creation, he says: O Lord, male or female? O Lord, damned or saved? What is the provision? What is the lifespan? All of that is written in the womb of his mother.
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Thoughts: Allah forgives evil thoughts not acted upon
t: Abu Huraira reported: When the verse was revealed to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, “Unto Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, whether you reveal what is within yourselves or hide it, Allah will hold you accountable for it, as He forgives whomever He wills and punishes whomever He wills, for He has power over all things,” (2:284). This was hard on the Messenger of Allah’s companions so they came to him, knelt before him, and they said, “O Messenger of Allah, “We are held responsible for deeds we can accomplish, such as prayer, fasting, jihad, and charity, but this verse was revealed to you and we cannot live up to it.” Then, Allah revealed as a result, “The Messenger has faith in what has been revealed to him, as do the believers. Each of them believes in Allah, His angels, His books, and His messengers. They make no distinction between any of His messengers. They say, ‘We listen and we obey, we ask Your forgiveness our Lord and unto You is the final destination.’ Allah does not hold a soul accountable except what is within its power. It will be rewarded for what it has earned and taken to account for what it has earned. Our Lord, do not blame us if we forget or err. Our Lord, do not burden us as You have burdened those before us. Our Lord, do not overwhelm us with what we cannot endure. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our guardian, so support us against the people who disbelieve.” (2:285)
q: Unto Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, whether you reveal what is within yourselves or hide it, Allah will hold you accountable for it, as He forgives whomever He wills and punishes whomever He wills, for He has power over all things, … The Messenger has faith in what has been revealed to him, as do the believers. Each of them believes in Allah, His angels, His books, and His messengers. They make no distinction between any of His messengers. They say, ‘We listen and we obey, we ask Your forgiveness our Lord and unto You is the final destination.’ Allah does not hold a soul accountable except what is within its power. It will be rewarded for … what it has earned and taken to account for what it has earned. Our Lord, do not blame us if we forget or err. Our Lord, do not burden us as You have burdened those before us. Our Lord, do not overwhelm us with what we cannot endure. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our guardian, so support us against the people who disbelieve.

title: Hadith on Gazing: First glances forgiven, second sinful
t: Ali reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Do not follow one glance at a woman with another. You are excused for the first but the second will be counted against you.”
q: Do not follow one glance at a woman with another. You are excused for the first but the second will be counted against you.

title: Hadith on Qadr: Act upon commands of Allah for salvation
t: Abdur Rahman ibn Qatadah reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Allah created Adam and then took hold of the creation from behind, saying: These were created for Paradise and I am not concerned, and these were created for Hellfire and I am not concerned.” It was said, “O Messenger of Allah, then upon what should we act?” The Prophet said, “Upon the fields of providence.”
q: Allah created Adam and then took hold of the creation from behind, saying: These were created for Paradise and I am not concerned, and these were created for Hellfire and I am not concerned. … Upon the fields of providence.

title: Hadith on Shaytan: Remembering believers make Satan tired
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, the believer can wear out his devils just as one of you exhausts his camel on a journey.”
q: Verily, the believer can wear out his devils just as one of you exhausts his camel on a journey.

title: Hadith on Dua: Supplications before leaving at end of prayer
t: Abdur Rahman ibn Ghanm reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever says ten times before departing the sunset and dawn prayers or moving his feet, ‘There is no God but Allah alone, without any partners, to Him belong the dominion and all praise, all goodness is in His hand, He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things,’ then ten good deeds will be recorded for him each time, ten bad deeds will be erased, he will be raised by ten degrees, he will be fortified from everything he dislikes and from the accursed Satan. No sin will be allowed to harm him but idolatry. He will be the best of people in deeds except for a man who surpasses him by saying it more often than him.”
