t: Al-Qurtubi reported: Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “The best jihad is to build a mosque and to teach the Quran, the Sunnah, and religious understanding therein.”

title: Hadith on Akhirah: Take care of your Hereafter, Allah takes care of the rest
t: Zayd ibn Thabit reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever is concerned about the world, Allah will disorder his affairs, make poverty appear before his eyes, and he will not get anything from the world but what has been decreed for him. Whoever is concerned about the Hereafter, Allah will settle his affairs, make him content in his heart, and the world will reluctantly come to him.”
q: Whoever is concerned about the world, Allah will disorder his affairs, make poverty appear before his eyes, and he will not get anything from the world but what has been decreed for him. Whoever is concerned about the Hereafter, Allah will settle his affairs, make him content in his heart, and the world will reluctantly come to him.

title: Hadith on Repentance: Glory to Allah, I seek your forgiveness
t: Aisha reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said these words often before he passed away, “Glory be to Allah and with His praise. I seek Your forgiveness and I repent to You.” I said, “O Messenger of Allah, I see you have said these words often.” The Prophet said, “My Lord has told me that I will see a sign in my nation and when I see it, I should say often: Glory be to Allah and with His praise, I seek Your forgiveness and I repent to You. I have already seen it in the verses: When the help of Allah comes and the victory, and you see people entering the religion of Allah in crowds, then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for He is ever relenting.” (110:1-3)
q: Glory be to Allah and with His praise. I seek Your forgiveness and I repent to … You … My Lord has told me that I will see a sign in my nation and when I see it, I should say often: Glory be to Allah and with His praise, I seek Your forgiveness and I repent to You. I have already seen it in the verses: When the help of Allah comes and the victory, and you see people entering the religion of Allah in crowds, then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for He is ever relenting.

title: Hadith on Ummah: No true Muslim violates their rights
t: ‘Ubadah ibn al-Samit reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “He is not part of my nation who neither honors our elders, nor has mercy on our young ones, nor acknowledges the rights of our scholars.”
q: He is not part of my nation who neither honors our elders, nor has mercy on our young ones, nor acknowledges the rights of our scholars.

title: Fudayl on Sunnah: Deeds accepted if sincere and according to Sunnah
t: Ibn al-Qayyim reported: Fudayl ibn ‘Iyad said, “Allah purifies good deeds and makes them correct. Indeed, if deeds are sincere and incorrect, they will not be accepted. If deeds are correct and insincere, they will not be accepted, but rather they are only accepted if they are both sincere and correct. Sincere means they are done for Allah alone and correct means they are done according to the Sunnah.” Then, Fudayl recited the verse, “So whoever hopes in the meeting with his Lord, let him work righteousness and associate none in the worship of his Lord.” (18:110)
q: So whoever hopes in the meeting with his Lord, let him work righteousness and associate none in the worship of his Lord

title: Hadith on Hawd: Oppressors will not meet at the Fountain
t: Ka’b ibn ‘Ujrah reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, rulers will come after me and whoever enters their audience, affirms their lies, and supports their oppression, they are not part of me and I am not part of them. They will have no presence at the Fountain. Whoever does not enter their audience, does not support their oppression, and does not affirm their lies, he is part of me and I am part of him. He will be present at the Fountain.”
q: Verily, rulers will come after me and whoever enters their audience, affirms their lies, and supports their oppression, they are not part of me and I am not part of them. They will have no presence at the Fountain. Whoever does not enter their audience, does not support their oppression, and does not affirm their lies, he is part of me and I am part of him. He will be present at the Fountain.

title: Hasan on Tyranny: Evil leaders are punishment from Allah
t: Ibn Taymiyyah reported: Hasan al-Basri, may Allah be pleased with him, would say, “Verily, the tyrant Al-Hajjaj is a punishment from Allah, so do not repel the punishment of Allah with your hands. Rather, you must be humble and submissive.”

title: Hadith on Istighfar: Allah forgives you unless you stop asking
t: ‘Uqbah ibn ‘Amir reported: A man came to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, and he said, “O Messenger of Allah, one of us has committed a sin.” The Prophet said, “It will be written against him.” The man said, “Then he has sought forgiveness and repented.” The Prophet said, “He will be forgiven and his repentance accepted.” The man said, “Then he returns to committing a sin.” The Prophet said, “It will be written against him.” The man said, “Then he has sought forgiveness and repented.” The Prophet said, “He will be forgiven and his repentance accepted. Allah will not tire of forgiveness unless you are tired of asking.”
q: It will be written against him … He will be forgiven and his repentance accepted … It will be written against him … He will be forgiven and his repentance accepted. Allah will not tire of forgiveness unless you are tired of asking.

title: Hadith on Nifaq: Severe punishment for hypocritical preachers
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “I saw some men on the night of my ascension, whose lips were being sheared by scissors of fire. I said: O Gabriel, who are these people? Gabriel said: Preachers from your nation who commanded people to be righteous but they forgot it themselves, yet they recited the Book. Will they not reason?”
q: I saw some men on the night of my ascension, whose lips were being sheared by scissors of fire. I said: O Gabriel, who are these people? Gabriel said: Preachers from your nation who commanded people to be righteous but they forgot it themselves, yet they recited the Book. Will they not reason?

title: Hadith on Dua: Make me independent of all besides you
t: Ali ibn Abi Talib reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “O Allah, suffice me with your allowances against your prohibitions and make me independent by Your favor of all those besides you.”
q: O Allah, suffice me with your allowances against your prohibitions and make me independent by Your favor of all those besides you.

title: Hadith on Eid: The Prophet prays Eid, then gives sermon
t: Ibn Abbas reported: I witnessed the prayer on the day of Eid al-Fitr with the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, and Abu Bakr, Umar, and Uthman, may Allah be pleased with them. They performed the prayer before the sermon, then would deliver the sermon.
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Eid: No call to prayer for Eid, voluntary prayers
t: Jabir ibn Samurah reported: I performed the Eid prayers with the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, more than once, without announcing the two calls to prayer.

title: Hadith on Eid: The Prophet encourages charity in Eid sermon
t: Abu Sa’id al-Khudri reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, would go out on the days of Eid and lead the prayer. When the Prophet finished the prayer and invoked peace, he would stand and turn to people while they were sitting in their places of prayer. If he needed to dispatch an expedition, he would mention it to the people. If he had another need, he would order them regarding it. The Prophet would say three times, “Give in charity.” The women would give the most of those who gave, then the Prophet would return.
q: Give in charity.

title: Hadith on Eid: The Prophet returns home by different paths
t: Jabir ibn Abdullah reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, would return on the day of Eid by using a different route from which he came.

title: Hadith on Eid: Wearing best clothes on Eid celebrations
t: Ibn Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, would wear a red-striped cloak on the day of Eid.

title: Hadith on Eid: Pronouncing Takbir until the Imam arrives
t: Nafi’ reported: Abdullah ibn Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, would depart to the Eid prayer from the mosque and he would raise his voice, declaring the greatness of Allah until he arrived at the place of prayer. He would continue to exalt Allah until the Imam arrived.

title: Hadith on Eid: Surat Qaf and al-Qamar recited in Eid prayers
t: Abu Waqid reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, would recite in the Eid prayers, “Qaf, by the majestic Quran,” (50:1) and, “The Hour approaches and the moon is cleft asunder,” (54:1).
q: Qaf, by the majestic Quran … The Hour approaches and the moon is cleft asunder,

title: Hadith on Eid: Surat al-A’la and al-Ghashiyah in Eid, Friday prayers
t: Al-Num’an ibn Bashir reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, would recite in the two Eid prayers and in the Friday prayer the chapters, “Glorify the name of your Lord the Most High,” (87:1) and, “Has there come to you the news of the overwhelming?” (88:1). If the Eid and Friday prayers occurred on the same day, he would recite them in both prayers.
q: Glorify the name of your Lord the Most High … Has there come to you the news of the overwhelming

title: Hadith on Eid: Seven and five Takbir in Eid prayer
t:
‘Amr ibn ‘Awf reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, would pronounce takbir during the Eid prayer seven times before the recitation in the first cycle, and five times before the recitation in the second cycle.

Al-Tirmidhi said, “This tradition is acted upon by some of the people of knowledge among the companions of the Prophet and others.”

title: Hadith on Eid: Perform Ghusl before attending Eid prayer
t: Nafi’ reported: Abdullah ibn Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, used to perform a ritual bath on the day of Eid before he would depart for prayer.

title: Ahmad on Sunnah: Not act on hadith until authenticated, understood
t: Ibn al-Qayyim reported: Abdullah ibn Ahmad said, “I asked my father Ahmad ibn Hanbal about a man who has books, within which are the sayings of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, and the companions and the followers, but he cannot distinguish weak and rejected narrations, nor a strong chain of narration from a weak one. Is it permissible for him to act upon whatever he wills, to choose from it, to give judgments by it, and to act according to it?” Ahmad, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “He may not act upon it until he asks what may be taken from it, such that he acts upon what is correct. He must ask the scholars about it.”

title: Hadith on Laylat al-Qadr: Night of Decree is peaceful and calm
t: Ibn Abbas reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said regarding the Night of Decree, “It is a calm night, neither hot nor cold, and the sun rises upon its day red and faint.”
q: It … is a calm night, neither hot nor cold, and the sun rises upon its day red and faint.

title: Hadith on Injustice: Allah gives respite to oppressors for short time
t: Abu Musa reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, Allah Almighty will give respite to the wrongdoer until He seizes him and they cannot escape.” Then, the Prophet recited the verse, “Such is the seizure of your Lord, when He takes hold of the cities while they are doing wrong. Verily, His seizure is agonizing and severe.” (11:102)
q: Verily, Allah Almighty will give respite to the wrongdoer until He seizes him and they cannot escape. … Such is the seizure of your Lord, when He takes hold of the cities while they are doing wrong. Verily, His seizure is agonizing and severe
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Fudayl on Rulers: Supplicating for guidance of Muslim leaders
t: Al-Dhahabi reported: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyad, may Allah have mercy on him, said, “If I had one supplication to be answered, I would make it for no one but the ruler. If the ruler is righteous, it will lead to the righteousness of the country and the people.”

title: Hadith on Dua: O Allah, grant me your love, strengthen me
t: Abdullah ibn Yazid reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, would supplicate, saying, “O Allah, grant me your love and the love of those whose love will benefit me with you. O Allah, whatever you have provided me from what I love, make it strength for me for that which you love. O Allah, whatever you have withheld from what I love, make it a time for rest in that which you love.”
q: O Allah, grant me your love and the love of those whose love will benefit me with you. O Allah, whatever you have provided me from what I love, make it strength for me for that which you love. O Allah, whatever you have withheld from what I love, make it a time for rest in that which you love.

title: Hadith on Fitnah: Trials coming full of senseless killing
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “By the one in whose hand is my soul, a time will surely come upon people in which the killer does not know why he has killed, and the one killed does not know why he was killed.”
q: By the one in whose hand is my soul, a time will surely come upon people in which the killer does not know why he has killed, and the one killed does not know why he was killed

title: Hadith on Charity: Generous person is close to Allah, close to Paradise
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The generous one is near to Allah, near to Paradise, near to the people, and far from the Hellfire. The miserly one is far from Allah, far from Paradise, far from the people, and near to the Hellfire. An ignorant generous person is more beloved to Allah Almighty than a stingy scholar.”
q: The generous one is near to Allah, near to Paradise, near to the people, and far from the Hellfire. The miserly one is far from Allah, far from Paradise, far from the people, and near to the Hellfire. An ignorant generous person is more beloved to Allah Almighty than a stingy scholar

title: Ali on Trials: Calamities due to sin, removed by repentance
t: Ibn al-Qayyim reported: Ali ibn Abi Talib, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “A trial is not sent down but due to a sin, and it is not lifted but with repentance.”

title: Umar on Qunut: Supplication of Umar during persecution
t: Ubaid ibn Umair reported: Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, supplicated after bowing in prayer and he said, “O Allah, forgive the believing men and believing women and the Muslim men and Muslim women, bring their hearts together and reconcile between them, support them against Your enemies and their enemies. O Allah, the curse is upon those who disbelieved among the people of the Scripture, who obstruct people from Your path and have denied Your Messenger and have fought Your allies. O Allah, oppose their words and shake their footing and send upon them Your strength which the criminals cannot repel. In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful, we seek Your help and we seek Your forgiveness. We praise You, we do not deny You, and we disavow and abandon whoever is wicked to You. In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful, You alone we worship, we pray to You, we prostrate for You, we strive for You, we fear Your punishment and we hope in Your mercy. Verily, Your punishment of the unbelievers will be carried out.”

title: Hadith on Ramadan: The Prophet says Ameen climbing the Minbar
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, ascended the pulpit and he said, “Amin, amin, amin.” It was said, “O Messenger of Allah, you ascended the pulpit and said amin, amin, amin.” The Prophet said, “Verily, Gabriel came to me and he said: Whoever reaches the month of Ramadan and he is not forgiven, then he will enter Hellfire and Allah will cast him far away, so say amin. I said amin. Whoever sees his parents in their old age, one or both of them, and he does not honor them and he dies, then he will enter Hellfire and Allah will cast him far away, so say amin. I said amin. Whoever has your name mentioned in his presence and he does not send blessings upon you and he dies, then he will enter Hellfire and Allah will cast him far away, so say amin. I said amin.”
q: Amin, amin, amin … Verily, Gabriel came to me and he said: Whoever reaches the month of Ramadan and he is not forgiven, then he will enter Hellfire and Allah will cast him far away, so say amin. I said amin. Whoever sees his parents in their old age, one or both of them, and he does not honor them and he dies, then he will enter Hellfire and Allah will cast him far away, so say amin. I said amin. Whoever has your name mentioned in his presence and he does not send blessings upon you and he dies, then he will enter Hellfire and Allah will cast him far away, so say amin. I said amin.

title: Hadith on Worship: They get no reward for insincere worship
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “One might fast but he gets nothing from his fast except hunger. One might pray at night but he gets nothing from his prayer except fatigue.”
q: One might fast but he gets nothing from his fast except hunger. One might pray at night but he gets nothing from his prayer except fatigue.

title: Hadith on Mosques: Affirm faith of those who frequent the masjid
t: Abu Sa’id reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “If you see a man committed to the mosque, bear witness to his faith. Verily, Allah Almighty said: The mosques are only maintained by those who have faith in Allah and the Last Day, establish prayer and give charity.” (9:18)
q: If you see a man committed to the mosque, bear witness to his faith. Verily, Allah Almighty said: The mosques are only maintained by those who have faith in Allah and the Last Day, establish prayer and give charity

title: Hadith on Dua: To Allah we belong, to Allah we will return
t: Umm Salamah reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “No Muslim is afflicted with a calamity but that he should say what Allah has commanded him: Indeed, to Allah we belong and to Allah we will return. (2:156) O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it with something better than it. If he does so, Allah will replace it with something better.”
q: No Muslim is afflicted with a calamity but that he should say what Allah has commanded him: Indeed, to Allah we belong and to Allah we will return. … O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it with something better than it. If he does so, Allah will replace it with something better.”

title: Hadith on Dua: Three times morning and evening for protection
t: Uthman ibn Affan reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “No servant says this three times in the morning every day and in the evening every night but that nothing will harm him: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing can be harmed on the earth or in the heavens, for He is the Hearing, the Knowing.”
q: No servant says this three times in the morning every day and in the evening every night but that nothing will harm him: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing can be harmed on the earth or in the heavens, for He is the Hearing, the Knowing.”

title: Hadith on Ramadan: Sacred scriptures were revealed in holy month
t: Wathila ibn al-Asqa’ reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The scriptures of Abraham, upon him be peace, were revealed on the first night of Ramadan. The Torah was revealed after six nights of Ramadan had passed, the Gospel was revealed after thirteen nights of Ramadan had passed, and the Quran was revealed after twenty-four nights of Ramadan had passed.”
q: The scriptures of Abraham, upon him be peace, were revealed on the first night of Ramadan. The Torah was revealed after six nights of Ramadan had passed, the Gospel was revealed after thirteen nights of Ramadan had passed, and the Quran … was revealed after twenty-four nights of Ramadan had passed

title: Malik on Sunnah: If my opinion contradicts Sunnah, leave it
t: Ibn Abdul Barr reported: Malik ibn Anas, may Allah have mercy on him, said, “I am only a human being. I make mistakes and I am correct, so investigate my opinions. Whatever agrees with the Book and the Sunnah, take it. Whatever does not agree with them, abandon it.”

title: Hatim on Salat: How do you pray so well?
t: Rabah ibn al-Harawi reported: ‘Isam ibn Yusuf passed by Hatim al-Asamm, may Allah have mercy on him, while he was speaking in his assembly. ‘Isam said, “O Hatim, do you pray well?” Hatim said yes. ‘Isam said, “How do you pray?” Hatim said, “I establish the command, I walk with fear, I begin prayer with intention, I exalt Allah with grandeur, I recite with a measured recitation and reflection, I bow with reverence, I prostrate with humility, I sit to complete the testimony, and I invoke peace properly and according to the Sunnah. Then, I sincerely surrender the prayer to Allah Almighty and I return to myself with fear that it will not be accepted from me. I guard it with effort in this way until death.” ‘Isam said, “You may speak, for you do pray well.”

title: Hadith on Ramadan: Fasting Ramadan, three days a month
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Fasting the month of patience, which is Ramadan, and three days from every month is like fasting the entire year.”
q: Fasting the month of patience, which is Ramadan, and three days from every month is like fasting the entire year

title: Umar II on Justice: People are fit for justice, not sword and lash
t: Sa’ib ibn Muhammad reported: Jarrah ibn Abdullah wrote to Umar ibn Abdul Aziz, may Allah have mercy on him, saying, “Peace be upon you. To proceed: The people of Khorasan have become unruly to govern. Indeed, they are fit for nothing but the sword and the lash. If the leader of the believers gives me permission, I will enact this policy.” Umar wrote back to him saying, “Peace be upon you. To proceed: I have been informed of your letter in which you said the people of Khorasan have become unruly and they are fit for nothing but the sword and the lash, and you have asked me to give you permission. You have lied. Rather, they are fit for justice and their rights, so enact that among them. Peace be upon you.”

title: Hadith on Qiyam: Night prayer is two by two, plus witr prayer
t: Ibn Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The night prayer is performed two by two. If you worry that morning is near, pray one cycle as that will be your witr prayer.”
q: The night prayer is performed two by two. If you worry that morning is near, pray one cycle as that will be your witr prayer
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Fitnah: Each new era is worse than one before it
t: Al-Zubayr ibn ‘Adi reported: We came to Anas ibn Malik, may Allah be pleased with him, and we complained to him of what we suffered from the ruler Al-Hajjaj. Anas said, “Be patient, for an era will not come upon you but that what comes after is worse, until you meet your Lord. I heard it from your Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.”

title: Hadith on Ramadan: Allah saves people from Hell during Ramadan
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “On the first night of the month of Ramadan, the devils are chained and the jinn are restrained, the gates of Hellfire are closed and none of its gates are opened, the gates of Paradise are opened and none of its gates are closed, and a heavenly caller announces: O seeker of good, come near! O seeker of evil, stop short! Allah has those He saves from the Hellfire, and that is during every night.”
q: On the first night of the month of Ramadan, the devils are chained and the jinn are restrained, the gates of Hellfire are closed and none of its gates are opened, the gates of Paradise are opened and none of its gates are closed, and a heavenly caller announces: O seeker of good, come near! O seeker of evil, stop short! Allah has those He saves from the Hellfire, and that is during every night

title: Hadith on Jannah: Amazing rewards for kind words, charity, fasting
t: Ali ibn Abi Talib reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, in Paradise, are chambers whose outside can be seen from the inside, and whose inside can be seen from the outside.” A bedouin stood up, saying, “Who are they for, O Messenger of Allah?” The Prophet said, “For those who speak kind words, feed the poor, regularly fast, and pray to Allah at night while people sleep.”
q: Verily, in Paradise, are chambers whose outside can be seen from the inside, and whose inside can be seen from the outside. … For those who speak kind words, feed the poor, regularly fast, and pray to Allah at night while people sleep

title: Hadith on Dajjal: False Messiah will emerge from Khawarij
t: Ibn Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “People will appear who recite the Quran but it will not go beyond their throats. Every time a faction emerges it will be cut off.” I heard the Prophet say this more than ten times until he said, “The False Messiah will appear in their midst.”
q: People will appear who recite the Quran but it will not go beyond their throats. Every time a faction emerges it will be cut off … The False Messiah will appear in their midst

title: Hadith on Dajjal: False Messiah to emerge from Khawarij
t: Abdullah ibn Amr reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “There will emerge from the east some people from my nation who recite the Quran, but it will not go beyond their throats. Every time a faction of them emerges it will be cut off.” The Prophet repeated it, adding on the tenth time, “Every time a faction of them emerges it will be cut off, until the False Messiah emerges from their remnants.”
q: There will emerge from the east some people from my nation who recite the Quran, but it will not go beyond their throats. Every time a faction of them emerges it will be cut off … Every time a faction of them emerges it will be cut off, until the False Messiah emerges from their remnants

title: Wahb on Khawarij: Consequences of the Kharijite heresy, rebellion
t: Ibn Asakir reported: Wahb ibn Munabbih, may Allah have mercy on him, said, “I knew the early period of Islam. By Allah, the Kharijites never had a group except that Allah caused it to split due to their evil condition. Never did one of them proclaim his opinion except that Allah caused his neck to be struck. Never did the Muslim nation unite upon a man from the Kharijites. If Allah had allowed the opinion of the Kharijites to take root, the earth would have been corrupted, the roadways would have been cut off, the Hajj pilgrimage to the sacred house of Allah would have been cut off, and the affair of Islam would have returned to ignorance until the people would seek refuge in the mountains as they had done in the time of ignorance. If there were to arise among them ten or twenty men, there would not be a man among them except that he would claim the Caliphate for himself. With each man among them would be ten thousand others, all of them fighting each other and charging each other with unbelief until even the believer would fear for himself, his religion, his life, his family, his wealth, and he would not know where to travel or with whom he should be.”

title: Hadith on Jannah: 70,000 Muslims to enter Paradise without reckoning
t: Abu Umamah reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “My Lord has promised me that seventy thousand from my nation will enter Paradise without reckoning or punishment. Along with every thousand are seventy thousand more, and three more immeasurable groups of His choosing.”
q: My Lord has promised me that seventy thousand from my nation will enter Paradise without reckoning or punishment. Along with every thousand are seventy thousand more, and three more immeasurable groups of His choosing.

title: Ibn Mas’ud on Hudud: Avoid legal punishments as much as possible
t: Abu Wail reported: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “Avoid flogging and applying the death penalty upon Muslims as much as you can.”

title: Hadith on Hudud: Pardon criminal before notifying ruler, if possible
t: Abdullah ibn Amr reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Pardon the legal punishments between yourselves, for whatever offense reaches me must be punished.”
q: Pardon the legal punishments between yourselves, for whatever offense reaches me must be punished

title: Hadith on Companions: The Prophet is the brother of all believers
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “I wish I could meet my brothers.” The companions of the Prophet said, “Are we not your brothers?” The Prophet said, “You are my companions, but my brothers are those who have faith in me yet they never saw me.”
q: I wish I could meet my brothers … You are my companions, but my brothers are those who have faith in me yet they never saw me
gf: Hasan li ghayrihi (fair due to external evidence) according to Al-Arna’ut

title: Hadith on Nifaq: Majority of hypocrites are Quran reciters
t: Abdullah ibn Amr reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, most of the hypocrites in my nation are among its reciters.”
q: Verily, most of the hypocrites in my nation are among its reciters

title: Hadith on Honor: Nobility is in the fear of Allah, al-Taqwa
t: Samurah reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Social status is in wealth, but nobility is in the fear of Allah.”
q: Social status is in wealth, but nobility is in the fear of Allah

title: Umar on Chivalry: Masculine virtues are in reason, religion, character
t: Ziyad ibn Hudayr reported: Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “The honor of a man is in his religion, his chivalry is in his character, and his foundation is in his intellect.”

title: Umar II on Apostasy: Let them return to paying tribute, no punishment
t: Ma’mar reported: Some residents of the peninsula told me that some people had embraced Islam, but it was not long until they became apostates. Maymun ibn Mihran wrote to Umar Ibn Abdul Aziz, may Allah have mercy on him, regarding them and Umar wrote back saying, “Let them return to paying tribute and leave them alone.”

title: Hadith on Cats: How Abu Huraira got his nickname
t: Abdullah ibn Rafi’ reported: I said to Abu Huraira, may Allah be pleased with him, “Why were you nicknamed Abu Huraira?” Abu Huraira said, “I would tend to the sheep of my people, and I had a small kitten. I used to place it in a tree at night, and during the day, I would take it and play with it. So they nicknamed me Abu Huraira, ‘father of the kitten.’”

title: Hadith on Ease: The Prophet lightens prayer on occasion
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, I might begin the prayer and I intend to prolong it, but then I hear the crying of an infant. I will shorten the prayer as I know his crying will distress his mother.”
q: Verily, I might begin the prayer and I intend to prolong it, but then I hear the crying of an infant. I will shorten the prayer as I know his crying will distress his mother.
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Shade: Allah shades those who give relief
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever grants respite to someone in difficulty or relieves him, Allah will shade him on the Day of Resurrection when there is no shade but His.”
q: Whoever grants respite to someone in difficulty or relieves him, Allah will shade him on the Day of Resurrection when there is no shade but His.

title: Hadith on Salat: The Prophet would pray if ever distressed
t: Hudhayfah reported: If the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, was distressed about anything, he would pray.

title: Hadith on Akhirah: Paradise and Hellfire pray for believers
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever asks Allah for Paradise three times, Paradise will say: O Allah, admit him into Paradise! Whoever seeks protection from Hellfire three times, Hellfire will say: O Allah, save him from the Hellfire!”
q: Whoever asks Allah for Paradise three times, Paradise will say: O Allah, admit him into Paradise! Whoever seeks protection from Hellfire three times, Hellfire will say: O Allah, save him from the Hellfire!
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Dua: Nothing is nobler to Allah than supplication
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Nothing is more honorable to Allah Almighty than supplication.”
q: Nothing is more honorable to Allah Almighty than supplication.

title: Hasan on Leaders: Obedience to corrupt rulers is difficult, but necessary
t: Ibn Rajab reported: Hasan al-Basri, may Allah have mercy on him, said regarding the rulers, “They take charge of five matters: the Friday prayer, the congregational prayers, the Eid celebration, guarding the frontiers, and the legal punishments. By Allah, the religion will not be upheld without them, even if they are tyrannical and oppressive. By Allah, what Allah sets right by them is greater than their corruption. By Allah, obedience to them is difficult, but seceding from them is unbelief.”

title: Hadith on Faith: Renew belief by declaring Allah is One
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Renew your faith.” They said, “O Messenger of Allah, how can we renew our faith?” The Prophet said, “Say often: There is no God but Allah.”
q: Renew your faith. … Say often: There is no God but Allah.

title: Hadith on Sha’ban: Allah forgives everyone but idolaters, haters
t: Abu Musa reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, Allah looks down in middle night of Sha’ban and He forgives all of His creatures, except for an idolater or one carrying hostility.”
q: Verily, Allah looks down in middle night of Sha’ban and He forgives all of His creatures, except for an idolater or one carrying hostility

title: Umar on Humility: No good in us until we accept self-criticism
t: Al-Hasan reported: A man said to Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, “Fear Allah, O leader of the believers! By Allah, the matter is not as you said!” The people rushed to the man and they said, “Do not criticize the leader of the believers!” When Umar saw them crowding around the man, he said, “Leave him alone. There is no goodness in him if he did not say it to us, and there is no goodness in us if we do not listen.”

title: Hadith on Reward: Charity in the way of Allah multiplied
t: Abu Mas’ud reported: A man came with a bridled camel and he said, “This is in the way of Allah.” The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “You will have for it seven hundred camels on the Day of Resurrection; each of them will be bridled.”
q: You will have for it seven hundred camels on the Day of Resurrection; each of them will be bridled.

title: Hadith on Praise: Glorify Allah, seek forgiveness ten times
t: Salma Umm Rafi’ reported: She said, “O Messenger of Allah, teach me some words, but not too much for me.” The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Say Allah is the greatest ten times. Allah Almighty will say: This is for me. Say glory be to Allah ten times. Allah Almighty will say: This is for me. Say: O Allah forgive me. Allah will say: I have done so. If you say it ten times, Allah will say each time: I have done so.”
q: Say Allah is the greatest ten times. Allah Almighty will say: This is for me. Say glory be to Allah ten times. Allah Almighty will say: This is for me. Say: O Allah forgive me. Allah will say: I have done so. If you say it ten times, Allah will say each time: I have done so.
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Miracles: Trees bear witness to the Prophet
t: Ibn Umar reported: We were with the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, on a journey and a bedouin passed by us. When he came near, the Prophet said, “Where are you going?” The man said, “I am going to my people.” The Prophet said, “Would you like to bring goodness with you?” The man said, “What is it?” The Prophet said, “That you testify there is no God but Allah alone, without any partners, and that Muhammad is the servant of Allah and his messenger.” The man said, “Who will bear witness to what you say?” The Prophet said, “This tree is a witness.” The Prophet called the tree from the edge of the valley and it ploughed through the earth as it came until it stood before him. The Prophet asked for its testimony and it bore witness three times that he is the messenger of Allah. Then, it returned to the place where it grew. The bedouin returned to his people and he said, “If they follow me, I will bring them all to you. Otherwise, I will return alone to be with you.”
q: Where are you going … Would you like to bring goodness with you … That you testify there is no God but Allah alone, without any partners, and that Muhammad is the servant of Allah and his messenger … This tree is a witness

title: Shafi’i on Sunnah: Do not be amazed until he follows Sunnah
t: Yunus ibn Abdul ‘Ala reported: I said to Al-Shafi’i, may Allah be pleased with him, “Our companion Layth ibn Sa’d would say: If you see a man walking on water, do not be amazed by him until he shows that he follows the command of the Book and the Sunnah.” Al-Shafi’i said, “Even less, may Allah have mercy on him. Rather, if you see a man walking on water and flying in the air, do not be amazed by him until he shows that he follows the command of the Book and the Sunnah.”

title: Hadith on Omens: Following omens an act of idolatry
t: Abdullah ibn Amr reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever turns back from something due to seeing an omen, he has committed idolatry.” They said, “O Messenger of Allah, what is the expiation for that?” The Prophet said, “That he says: O Allah, there is no good but Your good, no omen but Your omen, there is no God besides You.”
q: Whoever turns back from something due to seeing an omen, he has committed idolatry. … That he says: O Allah, there is no good but Your good, no omen but Your omen, there is no God besides You

title: Hadith on Sajdah: Satan weeps when believers prostrate
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “When the son of Adam recites a verse of prostration and he prostrates, Satan withdraws and he weeps and he says: Woe to me! The son of Adam was commanded to prostrate and he prostrated, so he will go to Paradise. I was commanded to prostrate and I refused, so I will go to Hellfire.”
q: When the son of Adam recites a verse of prostration and he prostrates, Satan withdraws and he weeps and he says: Woe to me! The son of Adam was commanded to prostrate and he prostrated, so he will go to Paradise. I was commanded to prostrate and I refused, so I will go to Hellfire.

title: Ibn Mas’ud on Conscience: He is ruined if he does not recognize good
t: Tariq ibn Shihab reported: ‘Itris ibn ‘Urqub came to Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, may Allah be pleased with him, and he said, “He is ruined who does not enjoin good and forbid evil.” Abdullah said, “Rather, he is ruined who does not recognize good in his heart and reject evil in his heart.”
gf: Rijal al-Sahih (narrators are reliable) according to Al-Haythami

title: Umar on Hereafter: Never feel secure, never lose hope
t: Yahya ibn Abi Kathir reported: Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “If a caller from heaven announced that all people would enter Paradise together but for one man, I would fear that I am him. And if a caller announced that all people would enter Hellfire together but for one man, I would hope that I am him.”

title: Hadith on Akhirah: If he feared Me in world, he is safe in Hereafter
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, narrated from his Lord Almighty that He said, “By My might, I will never combine in My servant two fears or two securities. If he feared Me in the world, I will make him safe on the Day of Resurrection. If he felt secure from Me in the world, I will make him fearful on the Day of Resurrection.”
q: By My might, I will never combine in My servant two fears or two securities. If he feared Me in the world, I will make him safe on the Day of Resurrection. If he felt secure from Me in the world, I will make him fearful on the Day of Resurrection

title: Hadith on Life: Best people have long lives, many good deeds
t: Abu Bakrah reported: A man said, “O Messenger of Allah, who are the best people?” The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “One whose life is long and his deeds are good.” The man said, “Who are the worst people?” The Prophet said, “One whose life is long and his deeds are evil.”
q: One whose life is long and his deeds are good … One whose life is long and his deeds are evil

title: Hadith on Zamzam: Best water is in the world is Zamzam
t: Ibn Abbas reported: The Messsenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The best water on the face of the earth is Zamzam water. In it is food for nourishment and healing for illness.”
q: The best water on the face of the earth is Zamzam water. In it is food for nourishment and healing for illness

title: Hasan on Bid’ah: Innovation in religion replaces Sunnah like it
t: Al-Awza’i reported: Hassan ibn ‘Atiyyah, may Allah have mercy on him, said, “People do not contrive an innovation in their religion but that Allah will take away a Sunnah like it. Then, it will not return to them until the Day of Resurrection.”

title: Hadith on Charity: Types of ongoing charity after death
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, among the good deeds that will join a believer after his death are these: knowledge which he taught and spread, a righteous child he leaves behind, a copy of the Quran he leaves for inheritance, a mosque he has built, a house he built for travelers, a well he has dug, and charity distributed from his wealth while he was alive and well. These deeds will join him after his death.”
q: Verily, among the good deeds that will join a believer after his death are these: knowledge which he taught and spread, a righteous child he leaves behind, a copy of the Quran he leaves for inheritance, a mosque he has built, a house he built for travelers, a well he has dug, and charity distributed from his wealth while he was alive and well. These deeds will join him after his death

title: Hadith on Quran: Surat al-Ikhlas is one-third, al-Kafirun is one-forth
t: Abdullah ibn Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The chapter, ‘Say: He is Allah the One,’ (112:1) is equal to one-third of the Quran. The chapter, ‘Say: O unbelievers,’ (109:1) is equal to one-fourth of the Quran.” Ibn Umar said, “The Prophet would recite either of them in his two cycles before dawn prayer.”
q: The chapter, ‘Say: He is Allah the One,’ … is equal to one-third of the Quran. The chapter, ‘Say: O unbelievers,’ … is equal to one-fourth of the Quran
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Iman: Blessed are believers who never saw him
t: Abu Sa’id al-Khudri reported: A man came to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, and he said, “O Messenger of Allah, blessed is one who saw you and had faith in you.” The Prophet said, “Blessed are those who saw me and had faith in me. Blessed, again and again, are those who had faith in me and never saw me.”
q: Blessed are those who saw me and had faith in me. Blessed, again and again, are those who had faith in me and never saw me

title: Hadith on Knowledge: Worldly life only has four types of people
t: Abu Kabshah reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, the world only has four kinds of people. There is one whom Allah has granted wealth and knowledge, so he fears his Lord in them, upholds family ties, and fulfills the rights of Allah over him. He is be in the best position. There is one whom Allah has granted knowledge without wealth. He has a sincere intention, and he says: If I had wealth, I would have acted like this person. If that is his intention, he will have the same reward as the other. There is one whom Allah has granted wealth without knowledge. He squanders his wealth in ignorance, he does not fear Allah in it, he does not fulfill his duties to his family, and he does not fulfill the rights of Allah over him. He will be in the worst position. There is one whom Allah has granted neither wealth nor knowledge, and he says: If I had wealth, I would have acted like this person. If that is his intention, he will have the same sin as the other.”
q: Verily, the world only has four kinds of people. There is one whom Allah has granted wealth and knowledge, so he fears his Lord in them, upholds family ties, and fulfills the rights of Allah over him. He is be in the best position. There is one whom Allah has granted knowledge without wealth. He has a sincere intention, and he says: If I had wealth, I would have acted like this person. If that is his intention, he will have the same reward as the other. There is one whom Allah has granted wealth without knowledge. He squanders his wealth in ignorance, he does not fear Allah in it, he does not fulfill his duties to his family, and he does not fulfill the rights of Allah over him. He will be in the worst position. There is one whom Allah has granted neither wealth nor knowledge, and he says: If I had wealth, I would have acted like this person. If that is his intention, he will have the same sin as the other

title: Hadith on Character: I swear by Allah on three qualities
t: Abu Kabshah reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “I swear an oath by Allah on three qualities and I will tell you about them, so memorize them: the wealth of a servant is not decreased by charity, a servant is not wronged by oppression and he endures it patiently but that Allah increases him in honor, and no servant opens the door of begging but that Allah opens for him the door of poverty.”
q: I swear an oath by Allah on three qualities and I will tell you about them, so memorize them: the wealth of a servant is not decreased by charity, a servant is not wronged by oppression and he endures it patiently but that Allah increases him in honor, and no servant opens the door of begging but that Allah opens for him the door of poverty

title: Hadith on Sharing: How the companions shared among themselves
t: Abu Musa reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, when the tribe of Al-Ash’ari run short of food during an expedition or among themselves in the city, they gather whatever they have in a single sheet and divide it equally between themselves. They are a part of me and I am a part of them.”
q: Verily, when the tribe of Al-Ash’ari run short of food during an expedition or among themselves in the city, they gather whatever they have in a single sheet and divide it equally between themselves. They are a part of me and I am a part of them
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Quran: Companions recite Surat al-‘Asr before parting
t: Abu Madinah reported: Whenever two men among the companions of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, would meet, they would not part until one of them recited to the other, “By the time, surely mankind is in loss,” (103:1) and the other would bid him farewell with peace.
q: By the time, surely mankind is in loss

title: Hadith on Sins: Allah forgives everyone but sinners in public
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Everyone from my nation will be forgiven except those who sin in public. Among them is a man who commits an evil deed in the night that Allah has hidden for him, then in the morning he says: O people, I have committed this sin! His Lord had hidden it during the night, but in the morning he reveals what Allah has hidden.”
q: Everyone from my nation will be forgiven except those who sin in public. Among them is a man who commits an evil deed in the night that Allah has hidden for him, then in the morning he says: O people, I have committed this sin! His Lord had hidden it during the night, but in the morning he reveals what Allah has hidden.
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Faults: Allah covers faults of those who covered faults
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “A servant does not cover the faults of another servant in the world but that Allah will cover his faults on the Day of Resurrection.”
q: A servant does not cover the faults of another servant in the world but that Allah will cover his faults on the Day of Resurrection

title: Hadith on Bukhl: What spiritual disease is worse than miserliness?
t: Jabir reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “What disease is more harmful than miserliness?”

title: Hadith on Iman: Renew faith in your hearts before it wears out
t: Abdullah ibn Amr reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, the faith of one of you will wear out within him, just as a shirt becomes worn out, so ask Allah to renew faith in your hearts.”
q: Verily, the faith of one of you will wear out within him, just as a shirt becomes worn out, so ask Allah to renew faith in your hearts.

title: Hadith on Trust: No faith for one who cannot keep a promise
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “There is no faith for one who cannot be trusted. There is no religion for one who cannot uphold a covenant.”
q: There is no faith for one who cannot be trusted. There is no religion for one who cannot uphold a covenant

title: Hadith on Sins: Magicians, drunkards not enter Paradise
t: Abu Darda reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The one who disobeys his parents will not enter Paradise, nor one who has faith in magic, nor the stubborn drunkard, nor one who denies providence.”
q: The one who disobeys his parents will not enter Paradise, nor one who has faith in magic, nor the stubborn drunkard, nor one who denies providence.

title: Hadith on Unity: Mercy in unity, punishment in division
t: Al-Nu’man ibn Bashir reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said upon the pulpit, “Whoever is not grateful for small things will not be grateful for large things. Whoever is not thankful to people is not thankful to Allah. Mentioning the blessings of Allah is gratitude, and ignoring them is ingratitude. Unity is a mercy, and division is a punishment.”
q: Whoever is not grateful for small things will not be grateful for large things. Whoever is not thankful to people is not thankful to Allah. Mentioning the blessings of Allah is gratitude, and ignoring them is ingratitude. Unity is a mercy, and division is a punishment

title: Hadith on Faith: Last words are there is no God but Allah
t: Mu’adh ibn Jabal reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “He whose last words are ‘there is no God but Allah,’ will enter Paradise.”
q: He whose last words are ‘there is no God but Allah,’ will enter Paradise

title: Hadith on Islam: Perform the five pillars, be kind to family
t: Abu Ayyub reported: A man came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and he said, “Tell me what I can do to enter Paradise and avoid Hellfire.” The Prophet said, “Worship Allah and do not associate anything with Him, perform the prayer, give in charity, and keep good relations with your family.” When the man turned away, the Prophet said, “If he adheres to what he has been commanded, then he will enter Paradise.”
q: Worship Allah and do not associate anything with Him, perform the prayer, give in charity, and keep good relations with your family … If he adheres to what he has been commanded, then he will enter Paradise
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Family: The Prophet does not cut off unbelieving relatives
t: ‘Amr ibn al-‘As reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, the relatives of my father are not my allies. Verily, only Allah and the righteous believers are my allies. Yet, they have the bonds of kinship and I will uphold their family ties.”
q: Verily, the relatives of my father are not my allies. Verily, only Allah and the righteous believers are my allies. Yet, they have the bonds of kinship and I will uphold their family ties
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Family: Bond of kinship under Throne of Allah
t: Aisha reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The bond of family is suspended from the Throne, and it says: Whoever upholds me, Allah will uphold him. Whoever severs me, Allah will sever him.”
q: The bond of family is suspended from the Throne, and it says: Whoever upholds me, Allah will uphold him. Whoever severs me, Allah will sever him
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Fever: Sickness is fire from Allah to expiate sins
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, visited a man who was sick and he said, “Be glad, for Allah has said: It is My fire that I afflict upon my sinful servant as his share in place of Hellfire.”
q: Be glad, for Allah has said: It is My fire that I afflict upon my sinful servant as his share in place of Hellfire

title: Hadith on Visiting: Angels bless one who visits a sick person
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever visits a sick person or visits his brother for the sake of Allah, a heavenly caller will announce: May you be blessed, may your walking be blessed, and may you dwell in a residence of Paradise!”
q: Whoever visits a sick person or visits his brother for the sake of Allah, a heavenly caller will announce: May you be blessed, may your walking be blessed, and may you dwell in a residence of Paradise
gf: Sahih li ghayri (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Murder: Good deeds not accepted from killers
t: ‘Ubadah ibn al-Samit reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever kills a believer without a just cause, Allah will not accept any of his obligatory or voluntary good deeds.”
q: Whoever kills a believer without a just cause, Allah will not accept any of his obligatory or voluntary good deeds

title: Hadith on Shirk: Allah may forgive any sin but idolatry and murder
t: Abu Darda reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Allah might forgive any sin except for one who died as an idolater or a believer who killed another believer on purpose.”
q: Allah might forgive any sin except for one who died as an idolater or a believer who killed another believer on purpose

title: Hadith on Zina: Would you like that for your mother, sister?
t: Abu Umamah reported: A young man came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and he said, “O Messenger of Allah, give me permission to commit adultery.” The people turned to rebuke him, saying, “Quiet! Quiet!” The Prophet said, “Come here.” The young man came close and he told him to sit down. The Prophet said, “Would you like that for your mother?” The man said, “No, by Allah, may I be sacrificed for you.” The Prophet said, “Neither would people like it for their mothers. Would you like that for your daughter?” The man said, “No, by Allah, may I be sacrificed for you.” The Prophet said, “Neither would people like it for their daughters. Would you like that for your sister?” The man said, “No, by Allah, may I be sacrificed for you.” The Prophet said, “Neither would people like it for their sisters. Would you like that for your aunts?” The man said, “No, by Allah, may I be sacrificed for you.” The Prophet said, “Neither would people like it for their aunts.” Then, the Prophet placed his hand on him and he said, “O Allah, forgive his sins, purify his heart, and guard his chastity.” After that, the young man never again inclined to anything sinful.
q: Come here … Would you like that for your mother … Neither would people like it for their mothers. Would you like that for your daughter … Neither would people like it for their daughters. Would you like that for your sister … Neither would people like it for their sisters. Would you like that for your aunts … Neither would people like it for their aunts. … O Allah, forgive his sins, purify his heart, and guard his chastity

title: Hadith on Welfare: Muslims only supported if helping the weak
t: Abu Darda reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Seek out your vulnerable on my behalf. Verily, you are only given provision and support from Allah due to the weak among you.”
q: Seek out your vulnerable on my behalf. Verily, you are only given provision and support from Allah due to the weak among you

title: Hadith on Poor: Allah supports by charity to weak
t: Mus’ab ibn Sa’d reported: Sa’d viewed himself as better than those below him. The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said to him, “Are you not given support and provision due to your vulnerable ones?”
q: Are you not … given support and provision due to your vulnerable ones

title: Hadith on Feasts: Worst feasts exclude the poor, refuse invitations
t:
Abu Huraira reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The most evil food is the food of a wedding banquet, in which those who want to come are left out and those who are invited refuse. Whoever does not answer an invitation has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.”

Abu Huraira said, “The worst food is the food of a wedding banquet, in which the rich are invited and the poor are left out.”

title: Hadith on Miskin: Do not turn away the poor believers
t: Sa’d reported: We were with the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, when the idolaters said to the Prophet, “Drive these people away, lest they turn against us.” The Prophet thought within himself whatever Allah willed him to think, then Allah Almighty revealed the verse, “Do not dismiss those poor believers who invoke their Lord morning and evening, seeking His pleasure. You are not accountable for them whatsoever, nor are they accountable for you. So do not dismiss them, or you will be one of the wrongdoers.” (6:52)
q: Do not dismiss those poor believers who invoke their Lord morning and evening, seeking His pleasure. You are not accountable for them whatsoever, nor are they accountable for you. So do not dismiss them, or you will be one of the wrongdoers.

title: Hadith on Death: Seek refuge in Allah from seven deaths
t: Abdullah ibn Amr reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Seek refuge in Allah from seven kinds of death: a sudden death, a snake bite, a predator, a fire, drowning, something falling above or below, and being killed whilst fleeing a marching army.”
q: Seek refuge in Allah from seven kinds of death: a sudden death, a snake bite, a predator, a fire, drowning, something falling above or below, and being killed whilst fleeing a marching army

title: Hadith on Hijamah: Best of your treatments are cupping, sea incense
t: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, the best practice with which you treat yourselves is cupping and sea incense. Do not torture your children with sore throats by pressing their throats with your fingers, but rather you must use incense.”
q: Verily, the best practice with which you treat yourselves is cupping and sea incense. Do not torture your children with sore throats by pressing their throats with your fingers, but rather you must use incense.

title: Hadith on Hijamah: There is healing in cupping, honey
t: Ibn Abbas reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “There is healing in three: a cupping operation, a drink of honey, and cauterization with fire, but I forbid my nation from using cauterization.”
q: There is healing in three: a cupping operation, a drink of honey, and cauterization with fire, but I forbid my nation from using cauterization

title: Hadith on Sadaqa: All involved in charity are rewarded
t: Aisha reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “When a woman spends in charity from the food of her house, without wasting it, she will have a reward from what she spent. Her husband will have a reward from what he earned, and the storekeeper will have a similar reward. Their rewards will not decrease each other at all.”
q: When a woman spends in charity from the food of her house, without wasting it, she will have a reward from what she spent. Her husband will have a reward from what he earned, and the storekeeper will have a similar reward. Their rewards will not decrease each other at all.
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Hasad: Cure your envy by blessing the envied
t: Sahl ibn Hunayf reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “If one of you sees something from his brother, or in himself, or in his wealth which impresses him, then supplicate for him to be blessed in it. Verily, the evil eye of envy is real.”
q: If one of you sees something from his brother, or in himself, or in his wealth which impresses him, then supplicate for him to be blessed in it. Verily, the evil eye of envy is real

title: Hadith on Dua: The Prophet seeks refuge for Hasan and Husayn
t: Ibn Abbas reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, would seek refuge for his grandsons Hasan and Husayn, saying, “Verily, your forefather would seek refuge for Ishmael and Isaac. I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and scourge and every harmful eye.”
q: Verily, your forefather would seek refuge for Ishmael and Isaac. I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and scourge and every harmful eye

title: Hadith on ‘Ayn: Beware evil eye of envy, perform ghusl
t: Ibn Abbas reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The evil eye is real. If anything could precede the divine decree, it would be preceded by the evil eye. When you are asked to perform a ritual bath, then do so.”
q: The evil eye is real. If anything could precede the divine decree, it would be preceded by the evil eye. When you are asked to perform a ritual bath, then do so

title: Hadith on Namimah: Gossip-monger will not enter Paradise
t: Hudhayfah reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The gossiper will not enter Paradise.”
q: The gossiper will not enter Paradise
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Qalam: First created was the Pen to decree existence
t: ‘Ubadah ibn al-Samit reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, the first to be created by Allah was the pen. Allah told it to write, so it wrote all that will exist until forever.”
q: Verily, the first to be created by Allah was the pen. Allah told it to write, so it wrote all that will exist until forever

title: Hadith on Ignorance: Knowledge gone if people stop applying Quran
t: Ziyad ibn Labid reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “There will be a time when knowledge disappears.” I said, “O Messenger of Allah, how can knowledge disappear when we read the Quran and we will teach it to our children until the Day of Resurrection?” The Prophet said, “May your mother be bereft of you, Ziyad! I thought you were the wisest man in Medina. Do not these Jews and Christians read the Torah and the Gospel, but they do not act upon what is in them?”
q: There will be a time when knowledge disappears … May your mother be bereft of you, Ziyad! I thought you were the wisest man in Medina. Do not these Jews and Christians read the Torah and the Gospel, but they do not act upon what is in them

title: Hadith on Sha’ban: Month people neglect between Rajab and Ramadan
t: Usamah ibn Zayd reported: I said, “O Messenger of Allah, I do not see you fasting any month as much as you fast during Sha’ban.” The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “It is a month people neglect between Rajab and Ramadan. It is a month in which the deeds are raised to the Lord of the worlds, and I like for my deeds to be raised while I am fasting.”
q: It is a month people neglect between Rajab and Ramadan. It is a month in which the deeds are raised to the Lord of the worlds, and I like for my deeds to be raised while I am fasting

title: Hadith on Bounties: Four blessings are the best in the world
t: Ibn Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever has four things has been given the best in this world and the Hereafter: a grateful heart, a tongue of remembrance, a body that can withstand with trials, and a wife not seeking betrayal in herself or his wealth.”
q: Whoever has four things has been given the best in this world and the Hereafter: a grateful heart, a tongue of remembrance, a body that can withstand with trials, and a wife not seeking betrayal in herself or his wealth

title: Hadith on Akhirah: Remember Hellfire in summer and winter
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “When the heat is severe, let it cool down for prayer. Verily, severe heat is from the raging of Hell. The Hellfire complained to its Lord, saying: My Lord, my parts are eating each other. It was given permission to make a breath in the winter and in the summer. They are the strongest heat you feel, and the strongest cold you feel.”
q: When the heat is severe, let it cool down for prayer. Verily, severe heat is from the raging of Hell. The Hellfire complained to its Lord, saying: My Lord, my parts are eating each other. It was given permission to make a breath in the winter and in the summer. They are the strongest heat you feel, and the strongest cold you feel.
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Umar on Knowledge: Learn and teach with dignity, humility
t: ‘Imran ibn Muslim reported: Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “Acquire knowledge and teach people. Learn with it dignity and tranquility, humility for those who teach you and humility for those whom you teach. Do not be tyrannical scholars and thus base your knowledge upon your ignorance.”

title: Malik on Honor: He loses honor as he praises himself
t: Ibn Wahb reported: Malik, may Allah have mercy on him, said, “Verily, when a man starts praising himself, his honor will disappear.”

title: Ibn Mas’ud on Fitnah: Sign of the Hour is many reciters, few scholars
t: Shaqiq reported: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, may Allah be pleased with him, said, “How will you be when you are afflicted with trials that make the old grow senile and the young grow old? And the people take the Sunnah, change it, and say it has been changed?” They said, “O Abu Abdur Rahman, when will this be?” Ibn Mas’ud said, “It will be when you have many reciters but few people of understanding, many leaders but few of them trustworthy, and the world is sought by the deeds of the Hereafter.”
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Ramadan: Living long life full of good deeds
t: Abu Huraira reported: There were two men from the tribe of Quda’ah who embraced Islam with the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. One of them was martyred and the other lived for another year. Talhah said, “I had a dream of Paradise and I saw the one who lived longer enter Paradise before the martyr. I was amazed by that so when I woke up, I mentioned it to the Prophet.” The Prophet said, “Did he not fast the month of Ramadan after him? And he performed six thousand or so bowings in prayer throughout the year?”
q: Did he not fast the month of Ramadan after him? And he performed six thousand or so bowings in prayer throughout the year?

title: Umar II on War: No killing women, children, civilians, non-combatants
t: Yahya ibn Yahya reported: I wrote to Umar ibn Abdul Aziz, may Allah have mercy on him, asking him about the verse, “Fight in the way of Allah those who fight you, but do not transgress,” (2:190). Umar wrote back to me, saying, “This refers to women, children, and whoever among them is not waging war against you.”
q: Fight in the way of Allah those who fight you, but do not transgress

title: Hadith on Ummah: Muslim nation protected from destruction, not killing
t: Sa’d reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “I asked my Lord for three matters. He granted me two of them, but withheld one. I asked my Lord for my nation not to be destroyed by famine, and he granted it for me. I asked my Lord for my nation not to be destroyed by drowning, and he granted it for me. I asked my Lord for there to be no bloodshed in my nation, but he withheld it from me.”
q: I asked my Lord for three matters. He granted me two of them, but withheld one. I asked my Lord for my nation not to be destroyed by famine, and he granted it for me. I asked my Lord for my nation not to be destroyed by drowning, and he granted it for me. I asked my Lord for there to be no bloodshed in my nation, but he withheld it from me

title: Hadith on Satan: Praise be to Allah, who repels evil whisperer
t: Ibn Abbas reported: A man came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and he said, “O Messenger of Allah, one of us has thoughts within himself, suggesting something that would make him love to be reduced to charcoal rather than to speak of it.” The Prophet said, “Allah is the greatest! Allah is the greatest! Allah is the greatest! All praise is due to Allah, who has turned back the plot of the whisperer.”
q: Allah is the greatest! Allah is the greatest! Allah is the greatest! All praise is due to Allah, who has turned back the plot of the whisperer

title: Hadith on Qarin: Everyone has a devil-companion who whispers
t: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Each one of you has a devil-companion from the jinn over him.” They said, “Even you, O Messenger of Allah?” The Prophet said, “Even me, yet Allah helped me against him until he embraced Islam. He does not order me to do anything but good.”
q: Each one of you has a devil-companion from the jinn over him … Even me, yet Allah helped me against him until he embraced Islam. He does not order me to do anything but good

title: Hadith on Shaytan: All people accompanied by devil who whispers
t: Aisha reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, left my apartment during the night and I became jealous. Then, the Prophet came and he saw I was upset. The Prophet said, “O Aisha, what is wrong? Do you feel jealous?” I said, “How can a woman not feel jealous with a husband like you?” The Prophet said, “Has your devil come to you?” I said, “O Messenger of Allah, is there a devil with me?” The Prophet said, “Yes.” I said, “Is he with all people?” The Prophet said yes. I said, “And with you, O Messenger of Allah?” The Prophet said, “Yes, but my Lord has helped me against him until he embraced Islam.”
q: O Aisha, what is wrong? Do you feel jealous? … Has your devil come to you … Yes … Yes, but my Lord has helped me against him until he embraced Islam

title: Hadith on Dunya: Craving for wealth, status corrupt religion
t: Ka’b ibn Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Two hungry wolves, roaming freely among a flock of sheep, are less destructive to them than the greed of a man for wealth and high status are to his religion.”
q: Two hungry wolves, roaming freely among a flock of sheep, are less destructive to them than the greed of a man for wealth and high status are to his religion.

title: Hadith on Virtues: Every Muslim who does these enters Paradise
t: Abu Dharr reported: I said, “O Messenger of Allah, what will save a servant from the Hellfire?” The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Faith in Allah.” I said, “O Prophet of Allah, what deeds must accompany faith?” The Prophet said, “He should give in charity from what he has been provided.” I said, “O Messenger of Allah, what if he is poor and does not find anything to give in charity?” The Prophet said, “He should enjoin good and forbid evil.” I said, “O Messenger of Allah, what if he cannot enjoin good and forbid evil?” The Prophet said, “He should work for the needy.” I said, “What if he, himself, is needy and unable to work?” The Prophet said, “He should support the oppressed.” I said, “What if he is weak and cannot support the oppressed?” The Prophet said, “You do not want your companion deprived of goodness! Let him refrain from harming people.” I said, “O Messenger of Allah, will he enter Paradise if he does that?” The Prophet said, “No Muslim acts upon one of these virtues but that it will take him by the hand to enter Paradise.”
q: You do not want your companion deprived of goodness! Let him refrain from harming people

title: Hadith on Thanks: Supplication to express gratitude, day and night
t: Abdullah ibn Ghannam reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever says in the morning, ‘O Allah, whatever favor comes to me has come from you alone without any partner, to you are praise and thanks,’ then he will have expressed his gratitude for the day. If he says similar to it in the evening, he will have expressed his gratitude for the evening.”

title: Hadith on Haya: Guarding chastity by modesty with nakedness
t: Abu Sa’id al-Khudri reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “A man should not look at the nakedness of another man, and a woman should not look at the nakedness of another woman. A man should not lie with another man under a single blanket, and a woman should not lie with another woman under a single blanket.”

title: Hadith on Haya: Allah has more right to your modesty
t: Mu’awiyah ibn Haydah reported: I said, “O Prophet of Allah, what can we cover or uncover of our nakedness?” The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Cover your nakedness, except from your wife or those in the custody of your right hand.” Mu’awiyah said, “O Messenger of Allah, what about when some people are with others?” The Prophet said, “If you are able to keep anyone from seeing it, do not let them see it.” Mu’awiyah said, “O Prophet of Allah, what about when one of us is alone?” The Prophet said, “Allah is more worthy of your modesty than people.”

title: Hadith on Tawbah: Man who repented for one hundred murders
t: Abu Sa’id al-Khudri reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “There was a man among the children of Israel who had killed ninety-nine people. Then he set out seeking repentance. He came upon a monk, and he asked him if his repentance would be accepted. The monk said no, so the man killed him. He continued asking until another man advised him to visit a certain village. He set out for it, but death overtook him on the way. As he died, he turned his chest toward the village. The angel of mercy and the angel of punishment argued about him among themselves. Allah ordered his destination to move closer to him and his old village to move away. Then, Allah ordered the angels to measure the distance between his body and the two villages. He was found to be one span closer to his destination, so he was forgiven.”
gf: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon) according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim

title: Hadith on Tawbah: Allah forgives until sun rises from west
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Whoever repents before the sun rises from the west, Allah will accept his repentance.”

title: Hadith on Tawbah: Allah delighted at repentance of Muslims
t: Anas reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Allah is more delighted at the repentance of His servant than one of you who lost his riding animal on a journey in a barren land while it carries his food and drink. He loses all hope as he comes to a tree to lie down in its shade, despairing over his animal, but suddenly he finds it standing over him. He takes hold of its reins and then he greatly rejoices, saying: O Allah, You are my servant and I am your Lord! He makes a mistake due to his great joy.”

title: Hadith on Tawbah: Repent to Allah seventy times a day
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “By Allah, I seek forgiveness from Allah and I repent to Him more than seventy times in a day.”

title: Hadith on Nikah: Best marriage and dowry are easiest, simplest
t:
‘Uqbah ibn ‘Amir reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The best marriage is one that is easiest.”

In another narration, the Prophet said, “The best dowry is one that is easiest.”
q: The best dowry is one that is easiest

title: Hadith on Brotherhood: Believers feel their pain together
t: Sahl ibn Sa’d reported: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “Verily, the believer among the people of faith is like the place of the head to the body. The believer feels pain for the people of faith, just as the body feels pain for the head.”
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Arna’ut

title: Hadith on Debt: Believer does not advance until debt paid
t: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said, “The soul of a believer remains suspended by his debt until it is paid.”
gf: Sahih li ghayrihi (authentic due to external evidence) according to Al-Albani

title: Hadith on Dhikr: Count remembrance of Allah on your fingers
